definition: used to emphasize that something is completely true
example: You're absolutely right.
definition_zh: 用来强调某件事完全真实
example_zh: 你说得完全正确。

definition: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities
example: high/low academic standards
definition_zh: 与教育相关，尤其是在学校和大学学习
example_zh: 高/低学术标准

definition: the opportunity or right to use something or to see somebody/something
example: High-speed internet access has become a necessity.
definition_zh: 使用某物或见某人/某物的机会或权利
example_zh: 高速互联网接入已成为必需品。

definition: to open a computer file or use a computer system
example: Most people use their phones to access the internet.
definition_zh: 打开计算机文件或使用计算机系统
example_zh: 大多数人用手机上网。

definition: a place to live, work or stay in
example: rented/temporary accommodation
definition_zh: 一个适合居住、工作或停留的地方
example_zh: 租赁/临时住宿

definition: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.
example: I don't have a bank account.
definition_zh: 就是某人和银行等达成的安排，用来把钱留在那里、取出一些钱等等。
example_zh: 我没有银行账户。

definition: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill
example: the greatest scientific achievement of the decade
definition_zh: 某人成功完成的事情，尤其是靠自己的努力和技巧完成的
example_zh: 本十年最伟大的科学成就

definition: a particular thing that somebody does
example: You have committed a serious criminal act.
definition_zh: 某人做的某件特定事情
example_zh: 你犯下了严重的犯罪行为。

definition: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service
example: The TV ads were first run last year.
definition_zh: 一张告知、图片或影片，向人们介绍某项产品、工作或服务
example_zh: 这些电视广告是在去年首次播出的。

definition: a thing that is added to something else
example: All of these technologies are fairly recent additions.
definition_zh: 一个被添加到另一个东西上的事物
example_zh: 这些技术都是相对较新的新增。

definition: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities
example: admire somebody/something, I really admire your enthusiasm.
definition_zh: 尊重某人所做的事情，或尊重他们的品质
example_zh: 欣赏某人/某事，我真的很佩服你的热情。

definition: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true
example: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.
definition_zh: 往往是不情愿地同意某件事是真的
example_zh: 我承认，那是件愚蠢的事。

definition: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.
example: Scientists are working on highly advanced technology to replace fossil fuels.
definition_zh: 拥有最现代、最新发展的理念、方法等。
example_zh: 科学家们正在研发高度先进的技术以替代化石燃料。

definition: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation
example: advise against doing something, I would strongly advise against going out on your own.
definition_zh: 告诉某人你认为他们在特定情况下应该做什么
example_zh: 建议不要做某件事，我强烈建议不要独自出门。

definition: to have enough money to be able to buy or do something
example: afford something, Can we afford a new car?
definition_zh: 有足够的钱买东西或做点什么
example_zh: 买得起点东西，我们能买得起新车吗？

definition: to become older
example: As he aged, his memory got worse.
definition_zh: 变老
example_zh: 随着年龄增长，他的记忆力变得越来越差。

definition: of the age of
example: They have two children aged six and nine.
definition_zh: 时代
example_zh: 他们有两个孩子，分别是六岁和九岁。

definition: a person whose job is to act for, or manage the affairs of, other people in business, politics, etc.
example: Our agent in New York deals with all US sales.
definition_zh: 一个工作是代表或管理商业、政治等他人事务的人。
example_zh: 我们在纽约的代理人负责所有美国销售。

definition: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody
example: an international peace agreement
definition_zh: 与某人达成的安排、承诺或合同
example_zh: 一项国际和平协议

definition: further forward in space or time; in front
example: I'll run ahead and warn them.
definition_zh: 在空间或时间上更前方;在前方
example_zh: 我先跑去警告他们。

definition: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve
example: the stated aims of the study
definition_zh: 做某件事的目的;某人试图实现的目标
example_zh: 研究的既定目标

definition: to try or plan to achieve something
example: He has always aimed high (= tried to achieve a lot).
definition_zh: 尝试或计划实现某件事
example_zh: 他一直志向高远（=努力追求很多成就）。

definition: a loud noise or a signal that warns people of danger or of a problem
example: She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).
definition_zh: 一种响亮的噪音，或警告人们危险或问题的信号
example_zh: 她决定拉响警报（=警告人们情况危险）。

definition: a book in which you keep photographs, stamps, etc.
example: a photo album
definition_zh: 一本可以保存照片、邮票等物品的书。
example_zh: 相册

definition: drinks such as beer, wine, etc. that can make people drunk
example: He never drinks alcohol.
definition_zh: 啤酒、葡萄酒等饮料，可能让人醉醺醺
example_zh: 他从不喝酒。

definition: connected with or containing alcohol
example: alcoholic drinks/beverages
definition_zh: 与酒精相关或含有酒精的
example_zh: 酒精饮料

definition: that can be used instead of something else
example: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.
definition_zh: 可以替代别的东西
example_zh: 路封闭了，所以我们不得不找另一条替代路线。

definition: very surprised
example: an amazed look
definition_zh: 非常惊讶
example_zh: 惊讶的表情

definition: something that you want to do or achieve very much
example: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.
definition_zh: 你非常想做或实现的事情
example_zh: 她实现了毕生的抱负。

definition: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
example: a fiercely ambitious young manager
definition_zh: 决心要成功、富有、有权势等等。
example_zh: 一位雄心勃勃的年轻经理

definition: to examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it
example: analyse something, The job involves collecting and analysing data.
definition_zh: 研究某物的本质或结构，尤其是通过将其拆分成各个部分，以便理解或解释它
example_zh: 分析某件事，这项工作涉及收集和分析数据。

definition: the detailed study or examination of something in order to understand more about it; the result of the study
example: statistical/data analysis
definition_zh: 对某事进行详细研究或检查，以进一步理解它;研究的结果
example_zh: 统计/数据分析

definition: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.
example: announce something, He officially announced his intention to resign at today's press conference.
definition_zh: 正式告诉别人一些事情，尤其是关于某个决定、计划等等。
example_zh: 宣布点什么，他在今天的记者会上正式宣布了辞职的意向。

definition: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something
example: to make an announcement
definition_zh: 一种口头或书面的陈述，用来告知人们某件事
example_zh: 发布一项公告

definition: to make somebody slightly angry
example: annoy somebody, His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.
definition_zh: 让某人稍微生气
example_zh: 惹恼别人，他不停的玩笑开始让她烦了。

definition: slightly angry
example: annoyed with somebody at/about something, He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.
definition_zh: 略带生气
example_zh: 对某人感到恼火，他开始对我的粗心大意感到非常恼火。

definition: making somebody feel slightly angry
example: This interruption is very annoying.
definition_zh: 让某人感到有点生气
example_zh: 这种打断非常烦人。

definition: separated by a distance, of space or time
example: The two houses stood 500 metres apart.
definition_zh: 被空间或时间的距离隔开
example_zh: 两座房子相距500米。

definition: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem
example: Why should I apologize?
definition_zh: 说你为做错事或惹出问题而道歉
example_zh: 我为什么要道歉？

definition: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, permission to do something or a place at a college or university
example: a planning/patent/visa application
definition_zh: 一份正式（通常是书面）的请求，比如一份工作、允许我做某事或在学院或大学的名额
example_zh: 规划/专利/签证申请

definition: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work
example: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.
definition_zh: 一种正式的约定，约定在特定时间见面或拜访某人，特别是出于与其工作相关的原因
example_zh: 我下午三点有个牙科预约。

definition: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something
example: Over the years he came to appreciate the beauty and tranquillity of the river.
definition_zh: 去认可某人/某物的优点
example_zh: 多年来，他逐渐欣赏到这条河的美丽与宁静。

definition: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct
example: The journey took approximately seven hours.
definition_zh: 用于表明某件事几乎准确或正确，但并非完全正确
example_zh: 整个旅程大约花了七个小时。

definition: the act of arresting somebody
example: The police made several arrests.
definition_zh: 逮捕某人的行为
example_zh: 警方逮捕了多名人员。

definition: if the police arrest somebody, the person is taken to a police station and kept there because the police believe they may be guilty of a crime
example: arrest somebody, A man has been arrested in connection with the robbery.
definition_zh: 如果警察逮捕某人，该人会被带到警察局并被关押，因为警方认为他可能犯了罪
example_zh: 逮捕某人，一名男子因抢劫案被捕。

definition: an act of coming or being brought to a place
example: We apologize for the late arrival of the train.
definition_zh: 来到或被带到某个地方的行为
example_zh: 我们为列车晚到致歉。

definition: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies
example: Students are required to complete all homework assignments.
definition_zh: 某人被分配去做的任务或工作，通常是作为其工作或学习的一部分
example_zh: 学生必须完成所有家庭作业。

definition: to help somebody to do something
example: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.
definition_zh: 帮助某人完成某事
example_zh: 任何愿意协助的人都可以联系这个号码。

definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth
example: Wind power doesn't release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
definition_zh: 环绕地球的气体混合物
example_zh: 风能不会向大气中释放二氧化碳。

definition: to fasten or join one thing to another
example: attach something, I attach a copy of my notes for your information.
definition_zh: 将一物固定或连接到另一物
example_zh: 附上点东西，我会附上我的笔记副本供你参考。

definition: the way that you think and feel about somebody/something; the way that you behave towards somebody/something that shows how you think and feel
example: attitude towards somebody/something, These societies have to change their attitudes towards women.
definition_zh: 你对某人/某物的想法和感受;你对某人或某物的行为方式，体现了你的想法和感受
example_zh: 对某人或某物的态度，这些社会必须改变他们对女性的态度。

definition: if you are attracted by something, it interests you and makes you want it; if you are attracted by somebody, you like or admire them
example: be attracted by somebody/something, I had always been attracted by the idea of working abroad.
definition_zh: 如果你被某样东西吸引，它会让你感兴趣并渴望它;如果你被某人吸引，你喜欢或钦佩他
example_zh: 被某个人或某物吸引，我一直被出国工作的想法所吸引。

definition: an interesting or lively place to go or thing to do
example: Buckingham Palace is a major tourist attraction.
definition_zh: 一个有趣或热闹的去处或活动
example_zh: 白金汉宫是主要的旅游景点。

definition: the power to give orders to people
example: in a position of authority
definition_zh: 向人下达命令的权力
example_zh: 处于权威位置

definition: to be equal to a particular amount as an average
example: Economic growth is expected to average 2% next year.
definition_zh: 以平均值等于某一特定金额
example_zh: 预计明年经济增长平均为2%。

definition: to make an official decision to give something to somebody as a payment, prize, contract, etc.
example: award something, Knowing why and how corporations award contracts is vitally important.
definition_zh: 为了正式决定把某样东西作为报酬、奖品、合同等方式送给某人。
example_zh: 授予某项协议，了解企业为何以及如何授予合同至关重要。

definition: knowing or realizing something
example: As you're aware, this is not a new problem.
definition_zh: 知道或领悟某事
example_zh: 正如你所知，这并不是一个新问题。

definition: towards a place or position that is behind
example: I lost my balance and fell backwards.
definition_zh: 朝向落后的某个位置或位置
example_zh: 我失去平衡，向后摔倒。

definition: to cook food in an oven without extra fat or liquid; to be cooked in this way
example: bake (something), to bake bread/biscuits/cookies
definition_zh: 在烤箱中烹饪时不添加额外脂肪或液体;以这种方式烹饪
example_zh: 烘焙（某样东西），用来烤面包/饼干/饼干

definition: a situation in which different things exist in equal, correct or good amounts
example: This newspaper maintains a good balance in its presentation of different opinions.
definition_zh: 一种不同事物以相等、正确或充足的比例存在的情形
example_zh: 本报在呈现不同观点方面保持了良好的平衡。

definition: to put your body or something else into a position where it is steady and does not fall
example: balance on something, How long can you balance on one leg?
definition_zh: 让你的身体或其他物体处于一个稳定且不会倒下的位置
example_zh: 站在某样东西上，你能单腿保持平衡多久？

definition: an official rule that says that something is not allowed
example: a smoking ban
definition_zh: 官方规则规定某项内容不被允许
example_zh: 禁烟令

definition: to decide or say officially that something is not allowed
example: ban something, The law effectively bans smoking in all public places.
definition_zh: 决定或正式声明某事不允许
example_zh: 禁止某件事，法律实际上禁止在所有公共场所吸烟。

definition: the lowest part of something, especially the part or surface on which it rests or stands
example: The lamp has a heavy base.
definition_zh: 某物的最低部分，尤其是它所依托或站立的部分或表面
example_zh: 灯座很重。

definition: to use a particular city, town, etc. as the main place for a business, holiday, etc.
example: be based in… , The organization is now based in Geneva.
definition_zh: 比如把某个特定的城市、城镇等作为开展业务、度假等的主要场所。
example_zh: 总部设在......，该组织现设在日内瓦。

definition: forming the part of something that is most necessary and from which other things develop
example: basic information/facts/ideas
definition_zh: 构成最必要的部分，并由此孕育出其他事物
example_zh: 基本信息/事实/想法

definition: the way things are organized or arranged; how often something happens
example: We are in contact on a regular basis.
definition_zh: 事物的组织或摆放方式;某件事发生的频率
example_zh: 我们保持定期联系。

definition: a device that is placed inside a car engine, clock, radio, etc. and that produces the electricity that makes it work
example: to replace the batteries
definition_zh: 一种安装在汽车发动机、钟表、收音机等内部的装置，并产生使其工作所需的电力
example_zh: 更换电池

definition: a fight between armies, ships or planes, especially during a war; a violent fight between groups of people
example: Napoleon was defeated at the Battle of Waterloo.
definition_zh: 军队、舰船或飞机之间的战斗，尤其是在战争期间;群体之间的激烈战斗
example_zh: 拿破仑在滑铁卢战役中被击败。

definition: the quality of giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind
example: beauty of something, the beauty of the sunset/of poetry/of his singing
definition_zh: 赋予感官或心灵愉悦的品质
example_zh: 某物之美，夕阳之美/诗歌之美/他歌唱的美

definition: a black and yellow flying insect that can sting (= touch your skin and make you feel a sharp pain).Bees live in large groups and make honey (= a sweet sticky substance that is good to eat).
example: Bees were buzzing in the clover.
definition_zh: 一种黑黄相间的飞行昆虫，能蜇人（=触碰皮肤并让你感到剧痛）。蜜蜂成群生活，产蜂蜜（=一种甜甜黏稠、适合食用的物质）。
example_zh: 蜜蜂在三叶草里嗡嗡飞舞。

definition: a strong feeling that something/somebody exists or is true; confidence that something/somebody is good or right
example: belief in something/somebody, I admire his passionate belief in what he is doing.
definition_zh: 强烈的感觉，认为某事/某人存在或真实;对某事/某人是善或正确的确信
example_zh: 对某件事/某人的信念，我钦佩他对自己所做的事情充满热情的信念。

definition: a hollow metal object, often like a cup in shape, that makes a ringing sound when hit by a small piece of metal inside it; the sound that it makes
example: A peal of church bells rang out in the distance.
definition_zh: 一种中空金属物体，形状通常像杯子，当内部有一小块金属击中时会发出嗡嗡声;它发出的声音
example_zh: 远处传来教堂钟声。

definition: a curve or turn, especially in a road or river
example: a sharp bend in the road
definition_zh: 一个弯道或转弯，尤其是在公路或河流中
example_zh: 路面上的一个急弯

definition: to lean, or make something lean, in a particular direction
example: He bent and kissed her.
definition_zh: 向某个特定方向倾斜，或者让某物倾斜
example_zh: 他俯身吻了她。

definition: to be useful to somebody or improve their life in some way
example: We should spend the money on something that will benefit everyone.
definition_zh: 为某人提供帮助或以某种方式改善他们的生活
example_zh: 我们应该把钱花在对所有人都有益的事情上。

definition: something that is better
example: the better of the two books
definition_zh: 更好的东西
example_zh: 两本书中较好的一本

definition: an act of biting
example: The dog gave me a playful bite.
definition_zh: 咬人的行为
example_zh: 狗还顽皮地咬了我一下。

definition: to use your teeth to cut into or through something
example: Does your dog bite?
definition_zh: 用牙齿切开或穿透某物
example_zh: 你的狗会咬人吗？

definition: a large piece of a solid material that is square or rectangular in shape and usually has flat sides
example: The houses are made of concrete blocks with tin roofs.
definition_zh: 一大块实心材料，形状为方形或长方形，通常侧面平坦
example_zh: 房屋由混凝土块和锡皮屋顶建造。

definition: to stop something from moving or flowing through a pipe, a passage, a road, etc. by putting something in it or across it
example: After today's heavy snow, many roads are still blocked.
definition_zh: 通过把东西放进管道、通道、道路等，阻止某物移动或流动
example_zh: 经过今天的大雪，许多道路仍然封闭。

definition: to get on a ship, train, plane, bus, etc.
example: Passengers are waiting to board.
definition_zh: 比如登上船、火车、飞机、公交车等等。
example_zh: 乘客正在等待登机。

definition: a weapon designed to explode at a particular time or when it is dropped or thrown
example: a bomb goes off/explodes
definition_zh: 一种设计成在特定时间或被投掷或投掷时爆炸的武器
example_zh: 炸弹爆炸/爆炸

definition: to attack something/somebody by leaving a bomb in a place or by dropping bombs from a plane
example: Warplanes bombed targets in and around the capital.
definition_zh: 通过在某个地方放置炸弹或从飞机上投掷炸弹来攻击某物或某人
example_zh: 战机轰炸了首都及其周边的目标。

definition: the line that divides two countries or areas; the land near this line
example: I live in a small town in the US, near the Canadian border.
definition_zh: 分隔两个国家或地区的界线;靠近这条线的土地
example_zh: 我住在美国一个小镇，靠近加拿大边境。

definition: to spend time and/or energy doing something
example: ‘Shall I wait?’ ‘No, don't bother’.
definition_zh: 花时间和/或精力做某件事
example_zh: “我要等吗？”“不用了，别费心了。”

definition: a part of a tree that grows out from the main stem and on which leaves, flowers and fruit grow
example: She climbed the tree and hid in the branches.
definition_zh: 树木的一部分，从主干长出，叶子、花朵和果实生长在其上
example_zh: 她爬上树，藏在树枝里。

definition: a type of product, service, etc. made or offered by a particular company under a particular name
example: a well-known brand of toothpaste
definition_zh: 由特定公司以特定名称生产或提供的一种产品、服务等类型
example_zh: 知名牙膏品牌

definition: to apply a brand name, image or identity to something
example: brand something, The website was not doing a very good job of branding the company.
definition_zh: 将品牌名称、形象或身份应用于某物
example_zh: 品牌方面，网站在品牌塑造方面做得并不好。

definition: willing to do things that are difficult, dangerous or painful; not afraid
example: brave men and women
definition_zh: 愿意做那些困难、危险或痛苦的事情;不害怕
example_zh: 勇敢的男女

definition: the air that you take into your lungs and send out again
example: His breath smelt of garlic.
definition_zh: 你吸入肺部并再次呼出的空气
example_zh: 他的呼吸中带着大蒜味。

definition: to take air into your lungs and send it out again through your nose or mouth
example: He breathed deeply before speaking again.
definition_zh: 吸入肺部的空气，然后通过鼻子或嘴巴再次呼出
example_zh: 他深吸一口气，再次开口。

definition: the action of taking air into the lungs and sending it out again
example: Her breathing became steady and she fell asleep.
definition_zh: 将空气吸入肺部并再次呼出的动作
example_zh: 她的呼吸变得平稳，随后睡着了。

definition: a woman on her wedding day, or just before or just after it
example: a toast to the bride and groom
definition_zh: 一位女性在婚礼当天，或者婚礼前后不久
example_zh: 为新郎新娘干杯

definition: a ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass
example: champagne bubbles
definition_zh: 液体中的一团空气或气体，或玻璃等固体物质内的一团空气
example_zh: 香槟气泡

definition: to place a dead body in the ground
example: bury somebody/something, They killed her and buried her body.
definition_zh: 把一具尸体埋进土里
example_zh: 埋葬某人/某物，他们杀了她，埋了她的尸体。

definition: past
example: Just drive by. Don't stop.
definition_zh: 过去
example_zh: 就开过去吧。别停。

definition: not excited, nervous or upset
example: It is important to keep calm in an emergency.
definition_zh: 没有兴奋、紧张或不高兴
example_zh: 在紧急情况下保持冷静非常重要。

definition: a quiet and peaceful time or situation
example: The police appealed for calm.
definition_zh: 一个安静平和的时光或情境
example_zh: 警方呼吁保持冷静。

definition: to make somebody/something become quiet and more relaxed, especially after strong emotion or excitement
example: Have some tea; it'll calm your nerves.
definition_zh: 让某人或某物变得安静、放松，尤其是在强烈情绪或兴奋之后
example_zh: 喝点茶;能让你平静下来。

definition: a series of planned activities that are intended to achieve a particular social, commercial or political aim
example: an anti-smoking campaign
definition_zh: 一系列旨在实现特定社会、商业或政治目标的计划活动
example_zh: 一场反吸烟运动

definition: to take part in or lead a campaign, for example to achieve social or political change, or in order to win an election
example: The party campaigned vigorously in the north of the country.
definition_zh: 参与或领导竞选活动，例如为实现社会或政治变革，或为赢得选举
example_zh: 该党在该国北部积极开展竞选活动。

definition: the buildings of a university or college and the land around them
example: university/college campuses
definition_zh: 大学或学院的建筑及其周围土地
example_zh: 大学校园

definition: a person who is trying to be elected or is applying for a job
example: a presidential candidate
definition_zh: 一个正在竞选或申请工作的人
example_zh: 总统候选人

definition: a type of soft flat hat with a peak (= a hard curved part sticking out in front). Caps are worn especially by men and boys, often as part of a uniform
example: to wear a cap.
definition_zh: 一种带有尖顶的软扁帽（=前方突出的硬弧形部分）。帽子主要由男性和男孩佩戴，常作为制服的一部分
example_zh: 戴帽子。

definition: the person in charge of a ship or commercial aircraft
example: Captain Cook
definition_zh: 船舶或商用飞机的负责人
example_zh: 库克船长

definition: not giving enough attention and thought to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes
example: careless driving
definition_zh: 没有足够关注和思考自己在做的事情，导致犯错
example_zh: 粗心驾驶

definition: a group of people or things with particular features in common
example: These are the nominees from each category.
definition_zh: 一组具有特定共同特征的人或事物
example_zh: 这些是各类别的提名作品。

definition: the top inside surface of a room
example: a large room with a high ceiling
definition_zh: 房间内侧的顶部表面
example_zh: 一间高挑天花板的大房间

definition: a special event that people organize in order to celebrate something
example: The occasion was the 40th anniversary celebrations of the orchestra.
definition_zh: 人们为庆祝某件事而组织的特别活动
example_zh: 这次活动是乐团成立40周年庆典。

definition: in the centre of an area or object
example: central London
definition_zh: 位于区域或对象的中心
example_zh: 伦敦市中心

definition: to be the person or thing around which most activity takes place; to make somebody/something the central person or thing
example: centre around/round somebody/something, State occasions always centred around the king.
definition_zh: 成为大多数活动围绕的人或事物展开;使某人或某物成为中心人物或事物
example_zh: 围绕某个人/某物展开，国家活动总是围绕国王展开。

definition: a public or religious occasion that includes a series of formal or traditional actions
example: More than 1 000 people attended the ceremony.
definition_zh: 包括一系列正式或传统活动的公共或宗教场合
example_zh: 超过1000人参加了仪式。

definition: a series of connected metal rings, used for pulling or fastening things; a length of chain used for a particular purpose
example: She wore a heavy gold chain around her neck.
definition_zh: 一系列连接的金属环，用于拉扯或固定物品;一段用于特定目的的链条
example_zh: 她脖子上系着一条沉重的金链。

definition: a new or difficult task that tests somebody’s ability and skill
example: a tough/major/significant challenge
definition_zh: 一项新的或困难的任务，考验一个人的能力和技能
example_zh: 一个艰难/重大/重大的挑战

definition: a person, team, etc. that has won a competition, especially in a sport
example: the world/European/national/Olympic champion
definition_zh: 一个赢得比赛的人、团队等，尤其是在某项运动中
example_zh: 世界/欧洲/国家/奥运冠军

definition: a television station
example: a television/TV channel
definition_zh: 一家电视台
example_zh: 一个电视/电视频道

definition: a separate section of a book, usually with a number or title
example: to read/write a chapter
definition_zh: 书籍中的一个独立部分，通常带有编号或标题
example_zh: 阅读/写章节

definition: the amount of money that somebody asks for goods and services
example: admission charges
definition_zh: 某人为商品和服务所要求的金额
example_zh: 入场费

definition: to ask an amount of money for goods or a service
example: The fees charged by some companies are excessive.
definition_zh: 向商品或服务索取一笔钱
example_zh: 有些公司收取的费用过高。

definition: for a low price
example: I got this dress cheap in a sale.
definition_zh: 价格低廉
example_zh: 这件裙子我是在打折时便宜买到的。

definition: a person who cheats, especially in a game
example: You little cheat!
definition_zh: 一个作弊的人，尤其是在游戏里
example_zh: 你这个小骗子！

definition: to trick somebody or make them believe something that is not true
example: cheat somebody/something, She is accused of attempting to cheat the taxman.
definition_zh: 欺骗某人或让他们相信不真实的事情
example_zh: 欺骗某人或某物，她被指控企图欺骗税务官。

definition: happy, and showing it by the way that you behave
example: You're not your usual cheerful self today.
definition_zh: 快乐，并通过你的行为表现出来
example_zh: 你今天可不是平时那个开朗的样子。

definition: connected with chemistry
example: changes in the chemical composition of the atmosphere
definition_zh: 与化学相关
example_zh: 大气化学成分的变化

definition: a substance obtained by or used in a chemical process
example: toxic chemicals
definition_zh: 通过化学工艺获得或用于化学工艺的物质
example_zh: 有毒化学品

definition: the top part of the front of the body, between the neck and the stomach
example: chest pains
definition_zh: 身体前部上部，位于颈部与腹部之间
example_zh: 胸痛

definition: the period of somebody’s life when they are a child
example: childhood, adolescence, and adulthood
definition_zh: 一个人童年时的人生阶段
example_zh: 童年、青少年与成年时期

definition: a statement that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not agree with or believe it
example: claim about somebody/something, The company had made false claims about its products.
definition_zh: 即便某事尚未被证明，且他人可能不同意或不相信，却是真实的陈述
example_zh: 关于某人/某物的声明，该公司对其产品作出了虚假声明。

definition: to say that something is true although it has not been proved and other people may not believe it
example: claim (that)…, He claims (that) he was not given a fair hearing.
definition_zh: 说某件事是真的，尽管它尚未被证明，其他人可能也不相信
example_zh: 他声称自己未获得公平的审理。

definition: a group of words that includes a subject and a verb, and forms a sentence or part of a sentence
example: in a clause, There are languages that require the subject to come before the object in a clause.
definition_zh: 一组包含主语和动词的词，构成一个句子或句子的一部分
example_zh: 在从句中，有些语言要求主语排在宾语之前。

definition: to remove things that are not wanted or needed from something
example: clear something, The settlers cleared the land and planted crops.
definition_zh: 从某物中移除不需要或不需要的内容
example_zh: 清理了些什么，定居者清理了土地，种了庄稼。

definition: the act of pressing the button on a computer mouse or touchpad
example: a mouse click
definition_zh: 按下电脑鼠标或触摸板上的按钮的动作
example_zh: 鼠标点击

definition: to choose a particular function or item on a computer screen, etc., by pressing one of the buttons on a mouse or touchpad
example: Click here to add your opinion to the survey.
definition_zh: 通过鼠标或触摸板上的任意按钮选择计算机屏幕上的特定功能或项目等
example_zh: 点击这里为调查提交您的意见。

definition: a person who uses the services or advice of a professional person or organization
example: She's a well-known lawyer with many famous clients.
definition_zh: 使用专业人士或组织的服务或建议的人
example_zh: 她是一位知名律师，客户众多。

definition: an act of climbing up a mountain, rock or large number of steps; a period of time spent climbing
example: an exhausting climb
definition_zh: 攀登山峰、岩石或大量台阶的行为;一段攀登时间
example_zh: 一段令人筋疲力尽的攀登

definition: near; not far away
example: + adv./prep., They sat close together.
definition_zh: 近在咫尺;不远
example_zh: + 副词/介词，他们坐得很近。

definition: material made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, etc.
example: woollen/cotton/linen cloth
definition_zh: 通过织造或编织棉、羊毛、丝绸等材料制成。
example_zh: 羊毛/棉/亚麻布料

definition: an object, a piece of evidence or some information that helps the police solve a crime
example: The burglar left no clues.
definition_zh: 一个物品、一件证据或有助于警方破案的信息
example_zh: 窃贼没有留下任何线索。

definition: to train somebody to play a sport, to do a job better, or to improve a skill
example: coach somebody, He has coached the team for five years.
definition_zh: 训练某人参加一项运动、更好地完成工作，或提升一项技能
example_zh: 教练，他已经执教球队五年了。

definition: a hard black mineral that is found below the ground and burnt to produce heat
example: I put more coal on the fire.
definition_zh: 一种坚硬的黑色矿物，藏于地下，通过燃烧产生热量
example_zh: 我又往火上加了些煤。

definition: a small flat piece of metal used as money
example: gold coins
definition_zh: 一小块扁平金属，用作货币
example_zh: 金币

definition: a group of objects, often of the same sort, that have been collected
example: He wanted to share his vast art collection with the world.
definition_zh: 一组通常为同类的物品，这些物品已被收集起来
example_zh: 他希望与世界分享他庞大的艺术收藏。

definition: having a particular colour or different colours
example: brightly coloured balloons
definition_zh: 具有特定颜色或不同颜色
example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的气球

definition: to come together to form a single thing or group; to join two or more things or groups together to form a single one
example: combine to do something, Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
definition_zh: 聚在一起形成单一的事物或群体;将两个或多个事物或群体结合起来，形成一个整体
example_zh: 氢和氧结合形成水。

definition: to express an opinion about something
example: He refused to comment until after the trial.
definition_zh: 表达对某事的看法
example_zh: 他拒绝发表评论，直到庭审结束之后。

definition: connected with the buying and selling of goods and services
example: residential and commercial properties
definition_zh: 与商品和服务的买卖相关
example_zh: 住宅和商业物业

definition: an advertisement on television, on the radio or on a website
example: a TV/television commercial
definition_zh: 电视、广播或网站上的广告
example_zh: 一则电视/电视广告

definition: to do something wrong or illegal
example: to commit a crime/an offence
definition_zh: 做错事或违法的事
example_zh: 犯罪/违法行为

definition: the activity or process of expressing ideas and feelings or of giving people information
example: communication between A and B, Good communication between team leaders and members is essential.
definition_zh: 表达思想和感受或向他人提供信息的活动或过程
example_zh: A和B之间的沟通，团队领导和成员之间的良好沟通至关重要。

definition: the process of comparing two or more people or things
example: For Durkheim, comparison was the most important method of analysis in sociology.
definition_zh: 比较两个或多个人或事物的过程
example_zh: 对涂尔干来说，比较是社会学中最重要的分析方法。

definition: used to describe a situation in which people or organizations compete against each other
example: competitive games/sports
definition_zh: 用于描述个人或组织相互竞争的情形
example_zh: 竞技游戏/体育

definition: a person who takes part in a competition
example: Over 200 competitors entered the race.
definition_zh: 参加竞赛的人
example_zh: 超过200名选手参加了比赛。

definition: a reason for not being satisfied; a statement that somebody makes saying that they are not satisfied
example: a formal complaint
definition_zh: 不满意的理由;某人说自己不满意的陈述
example_zh: 正式投诉

definition: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand
example: a complex problem/issue/process/system
definition_zh: 由许多不同的东西或相互连接的部分组成;难以理解
example_zh: 一个复杂的问题/问题/流程/系统

definition: to give all your attention to something and not think about anything else
example: I can't concentrate with all that noise going on.
definition_zh: 把全部注意力都放在某件事上，不去想别的
example_zh: 噪音太大我根本集中不了注意力。

definition: to decide or believe something as a result of what you have heard or seen
example: conclude something, It is too early for us to conclude anything.
definition_zh: 基于你听到或看到的事情而做出决定或相信某件事
example_zh: 得出结论，现在下结论还为时过早。

definition: something that you decide when you have thought about all the information connected with the situation
example: We can safely draw some conclusions from our discussion.
definition_zh: 这是你在考虑完与该情况相关的所有信息后才做出的决定
example_zh: 我们可以从讨论中得出一些结论。

definition: feeling sure about your own ability to do things and be successful
example: She was in a relaxed, confident mood.
definition_zh: 对自己完成事情和取得成功的能力感到有信心
example_zh: 她心情轻松自信。

definition: to state or show that something is definitely true or correct, especially by providing evidence
example: confirm something, His guilty expression confirmed my suspicions.
definition_zh: 陈述或证明某件事绝对真实或正确，尤其是通过提供证据
example_zh: 确认点什么，他那愧疚的表情证实了我的怀疑。

definition: to make somebody unable to think clearly or understand something
example: confuse somebody, These two sets of statistics are guaranteed to confuse the public.
definition_zh: 让人无法清晰思考或理解某事
example_zh: 让人困惑，这两组统计数据肯定会让公众困惑。

definition: unable to think clearly or to understand what is happening or what somebody is saying
example: I'm confused—say all that again.
definition_zh: 无法清晰思考，也无法理解发生了什么或别人在说什么
example_zh: 我很困惑——再说一遍。

definition: something that connects two facts, ideas, etc.
example: connection between A and B, Scientists have established a connection between cholesterol levels and heart disease.
definition_zh: 能把两个事实、想法等联系起来的东西。
example_zh: A和B之间的联系，科学家已经证实了胆固醇水平与心脏病之间的联系。

definition: a result of something that has happened, especially an unpleasant result
example: Remember that actions have consequences.
definition_zh: 这是某件事的结果，尤其是令人不快的结果
example_zh: 记住，行为是有后果的。

definition: to be made up of particular parts or things
example: The team consists of ten members.
definition_zh: 由特定部分或事物组成
example_zh: 团队由十名成员组成。

definition: to use something, especially fuel, energy or time
example: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
definition_zh: 使用某些东西，尤其是燃料、能量或时间
example_zh: 电力行业消耗大量化石燃料。

definition: a person who buys goods or uses services
example: consumer spending/demand
definition_zh: 购买商品或使用服务的人
example_zh: 消费者支出/需求

definition: the act of communicating with somebody, especially regularly
example: contact with somebody, I don't have much contact with my uncle.
definition_zh: 与某人交流的行为，尤其是定期沟通
example_zh: 和别人接触，我和我叔叔联系不多。

definition: to communicate with somebody, for example by phone, letter or email
example: I've been trying to contact you all day.
definition_zh: 与某人沟通，例如通过电话、信件或电子邮件
example_zh: 我一整天都在试着联系你。

definition: a box, bottle, etc. in which something can be stored or transported
example: a plastic container
definition_zh: 一个可以存放或运输物品的箱子、瓶子等
example_zh: 一个塑料容器

definition: the things that are contained in something
example: He tipped the contents of the bag onto the table.
definition_zh: 包含在某物中的事物
example_zh: 他把袋子里的东西倒在桌上。

definition: happening or existing for a period of time without being interrupted
example: Recovery after the accident will be a continuous process that may take several months.
definition_zh: 发生或存在一段时间且未被中断
example_zh: 事故后的康复将是一个持续的过程，可能需要数月时间。

definition: a difference between two or more people or things that you can see clearly when they are compared or put close together; the fact of comparing two or more things in order to show the differences between them
example: The two cities make an interesting contrast.
definition_zh: 两个或多个人或事物之间，当比较或放在一起时你能清楚地看到的差异;比较两个或多个事物以展示它们之间的差异这一事实
example_zh: 这两座城市形成了有趣的对比。

definition: to compare two things in order to show the differences between them
example: contrast A and B, The poem contrasts youth and age.
definition_zh: 比较两件事，以展示它们之间的差异
example_zh: 对比A和B，诗中对比了青春与年龄。

definition: useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems
example: Fruit is a convenient source of vitamins and energy.
definition_zh: 实用、简单或快速完成;不造成问题
example_zh: 水果是维生素和能量的便捷来源。

definition: to make somebody/yourself believe that something is true
example: convince somebody/yourself, Are the prime minister's assurances enough to convince the public?
definition_zh: 让某人/你自己相信某件事是真的
example_zh: 说服别人/说服自己，总理的保证足以说服公众吗？

definition: to become cool or cooler; to make somebody/something become cool or cooler
example: Glass contracts as it cools.
definition_zh: 变得酷或更酷;让某人/某物变得酷或更酷
example_zh: 玻璃冷却时会收缩。

definition: the clothes worn by people from a particular place or during a particular historical period
example: an exhibition of Victorian costumes
definition_zh: 来自特定地点或特定历史时期的人们所穿的服装
example_zh: 维多利亚时代服饰展览

definition: a small house, especially in the country
example: a thatched cottage
definition_zh: 一栋小房子，尤其是在乡村里
example_zh: 茅草屋

definition: a plant grown in warm countries for the soft white hairs around its seeds that are used to make cloth and thread
example: From the age of six she worked in the fields, picking cotton.
definition_zh: 一种生长在温暖地区的植物，因其种子周围柔软的白色毛发，这些毛被用来制作布料和线
example_zh: 从六岁起，她就在田里干活，摘棉花。

definition: an act of counting to find the total number of somebody/something
example: If the election result is close, there will be a second count.
definition_zh: 通过计数来计算某个人/某物的总数
example_zh: 如果选举结果接近，将进行第二次计票。

definition: land outside towns and cities, with fields, woods, etc.
example: The surrounding countryside is windswept and rocky.
definition_zh: 城镇外的土地，包括田地、树林等。
example_zh: 周围的乡村风吹拂，岩石丛生。

definition: the place where legal trials take place and where crimes, etc. are judged
example: the civil/criminal courts
definition_zh: 法律审判进行的地方，以及犯罪等案件被审判的地方
example_zh: 民事/刑事法院

definition: a thing that is put over or on another thing, usually to protect it or to decorate it
example: Brighten up your room with some colourful cushion covers.
definition_zh: 一种覆盖在别的东西上或覆盖在其他东西上的东西，通常是为了保护它或装饰它
example_zh: 用色彩丰富的靠垫套点亮你的房间。

definition: having a layer or amount of something on it
example: His face was covered in blood.
definition_zh: 在上面有一层或一定量的某物
example_zh: 他的脸上满是鲜血。

definition: between yellow and white in colour
example: a cream linen suit
definition_zh: 颜色介于黄色和白色之间
example_zh: 奶油色亚麻西装

definition: connected with or involving crime
example: criminal offences/activities
definition_zh: 与犯罪有关或涉及犯罪
example_zh: 犯罪/活动

definition: having a desire to cause physical or mental pain and make somebody suffer
example: He was known to be a cruel dictator.
definition_zh: 想要造成身体或精神上的痛苦，并让他人受苦
example_zh: 他以残忍的独裁者著称。

definition: connected with the culture of a particular society or group, its customs, beliefs, etc.
example: Teachers need to be aware of cultural differences.
definition_zh: 与特定社会或群体的文化、习俗、信仰等相关。
example_zh: 教师需要意识到文化差异。

definition: the system of money that a country uses
example: trading in foreign currencies
definition_zh: 一个国家使用的货币体系
example_zh: 外币交易

definition: happening now; of the present time
example: The necklace would be worth over $5 000 at current prices.
definition_zh: 正在发生的事;属于当下
example_zh: 按当前价格，这条项链价值超过5000美元。

definition: at the present time
example: The hourly charge is currently £35.
definition_zh: 目前
example_zh: 目前按小时收费为35英镑。

definition: a piece of cloth that is hung to cover a window
example: to draw/pull/close the curtains (= to pull them across the window so they cover it)
definition_zh: 一块挂在窗户上用来遮盖的布
example_zh: 拉上/拉下/拉上窗帘（=把窗帘拉到窗户上，遮住窗户）

definition: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community
example: It's a local custom.
definition_zh: 一种社会或社区中被接受的行为方式或做事方式
example_zh: 这是当地的习俗。

definition: a wound caused by something sharp
example: cuts and bruises on the face
definition_zh: 一道被尖锐物造成伤口的伤口
example_zh: 脸上的割伤和淤青

definition: every day
example: The machines are inspected twice daily.
definition_zh: 每天
example_zh: 这些机器每天接受两次检查。

definition: physical harm caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful or valuable
example: serious/severe damage
definition_zh: 对某物造成的物理伤害，使其变得不那么有吸引力、不那么有用或不够有价值
example_zh: 严重/严重损伤

definition: to have a bad or harmful effect on something/somebody
example: The church was badly damaged by the 1997 earthquake.
definition_zh: 对某事或某人产生不良或有害的影响
example_zh: 教堂在1997年的地震中遭受严重破坏。

definition: an agreement, especially in business, on particular conditions for buying or doing something
example: to sign/strike/finalize/close a deal
definition_zh: 特别是在商业领域，关于购买或做某事的具体条件达成协议
example_zh: 签署/罢免/敲定/达成交易

definition: a period of ten years, especially a continuous period, such as 1910–1919 or 2000–2009
example: the early decades of the nineteenth century
definition_zh: 十年间的时期，尤其是连续的时期，如1910–1919年或2000–2009年
example_zh: 十九世纪早期的几十年

definition: to make something look more attractive by putting things on it
example: decorate something with something, They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.
definition_zh: 通过在上面放东西让它看起来更有吸引力
example_zh: 用点东西装饰，他们用花和气球装饰房间。

definition: a long way below the surface of something or a long way inside or into something
example: Dig deeper!
definition_zh: 深藏在某物表面之下，或深深地潜入某物内部或深入某物之中
example_zh: 挖深一点！

definition: to say or explain what the meaning of a word or phrase is
example: define something, The term ‘normal’ is difficult to define.
definition_zh: 说或解释一个词或短语的含义
example_zh: 定义一下，“正常”这个词很难定义。

definition: sure or certain; unlikely to change
example: Can you give me a definite answer by tomorrow?
definition_zh: 确定或确定;不太可能改变
example_zh: 你能在明天之前给我一个明确的答复吗？

definition: an explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase, especially in a dictionary
example: The dictionary provides clear, simple definitions.
definition_zh: 对单词或短语含义的解释，尤其是在词典中
example_zh: 该词典提供了清晰、简单的定义。

definition: to take goods, letters, etc. to the person or people they have been sent to
example: deliver something, I get my food delivered from the supermarket to save time.
definition_zh: 将货物、信件等送达给被寄送的人
example_zh: 送点东西，我就让超市送餐来省时间。

definition: an act of leaving a place
example: His sudden departure threw the office into chaos.
definition_zh: 离开一个地方的行为
example_zh: 他的突然离开让办公室陷入混乱。

definition: used to show that something happened or is true although something else might have happened to prevent it
example: Her voice was shaking despite all her efforts to control it.
definition_zh: 用于表示某件事发生了或为真，尽管可能发生了其他事情以防止它发生
example_zh: 尽管她极力控制，声音依然颤抖。

definition: a place to which somebody/something is going or being sent
example: popular tourist/holiday destinations like the Bahamas
definition_zh: 某人/某物要去或被送往的地方
example_zh: 巴哈马等热门旅游/度假目的地

definition: to discover the facts about something; to calculate something exactly
example: determine something, An inquiry was set up to determine the cause of the accident.
definition_zh: 去发现某件事的事实;精确计算某件事
example_zh: 查明点什么，已经成立调查以查明事故原因。

definition: having made a definite decision to do something and not letting anyone prevent you
example: The opposition to her plan made her more determined than ever.
definition_zh: 做出明确决定，不让任何人阻止你
example_zh: 反对她计划的声音让她比以往任何时候都更加坚定。

definition: the steady growth of something so that it becomes more advanced, stronger, etc.
example: a baby’s development in the womb
definition_zh: 某样东西的稳定成长，使其变得更先进、更强大等等。
example_zh: 胎儿在子宫内的发育

definition: a simple drawing using lines to explain where something is, how something works, etc.
example: The results are shown in diagram 2.
definition_zh: 用线条简单地画出某物的位置、如何运作等等。
example_zh: 结果如图2所示。

definition: a clear precious stone of pure carbon, the hardest substance known. Diamonds are used in jewellery and also in industry, especially for cutting glass.
example: a diamond ring/necklace
definition_zh: 一种透明的纯碳宝石，是已知最坚硬的物质。钻石用于珠宝制作，也用于工业，尤其是切割玻璃。
example_zh: 一枚钻戒/项链

definition: a problem; a thing or situation that causes problems
example: the difficulties of English syntax
definition_zh: 一个问题;一个引发问题的事物或情境
example_zh: 英语句法的困难

definition: without stopping or changing direction or vehicle
example: direct to something, We flew direct to Hong Kong.
definition_zh: 无需停车、改变方向或车辆
example_zh: 直飞某处，我们直接飞到香港。

definition: to control or be in charge of somebody/something
example: He was asked to take command and direct operations.
definition_zh: 控制或掌控某人/某物
example_zh: 他被要求接管指挥并指挥作战行动。

definition: without stopping or changing direction
example: The path leads directly to the river.
definition_zh: 无需停车或改变方向
example_zh: 这条路直接通向河边。

definition: any substance that makes something dirty, for example dust, soil or mud
example: His clothes were covered in dirt.
definition_zh: 任何使某物变脏的物质，例如灰尘、土壤或泥巴
example_zh: 他的衣服全是泥土。

definition: something that causes problems and tends to stop somebody/something from succeeding or making progress
example: a serious/severe/significant disadvantage
definition_zh: 会引发问题，并往往阻碍某人或某物成功或取得进展的事
example_zh: 严重/严重/显著劣势

definition: upset because something you hoped for has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected
example: The singer has promised to refund any disappointed fans.
definition_zh: 因为你所期望的事情没有发生，或者没有像你预期的那样好、成功等而感到沮丧
example_zh: 这位歌手承诺会为任何失望的粉丝退款。

definition: not as good, successful, etc. as you had hoped; making you feel disappointed
example: a disappointing result/performance/defeat
definition_zh: 没有你期望的那么好、那么成功;让你感到失望
example_zh: 令人失望的结果/表现/失利

definition: an amount of money that is taken off the usual cost of something
example: to get/offer a discount
definition_zh: 从某项物品通常成本中扣除的金额
example_zh: 获取/提供折扣

definition: a feeling of not liking somebody/something
example: dislike of somebody/something, He did not try to hide his dislike of his boss.
definition_zh: 一种不喜欢某人或某物的感觉
example_zh: 对某人/某物的厌恶，他从不试图掩饰对老板的厌恶。

definition: to not like somebody/something
example: dislike somebody/something, Why do you dislike him so much?
definition_zh: 不喜欢某人/某物
example_zh: 讨厌某人或某事，为什么那么讨厌他？

definition: to separate into parts; to make something separate into parts
example: The cells began to divide rapidly.
definition_zh: 把东西分成一些部分;让某样东西分成几部分
example_zh: 细胞开始迅速分裂。

definition: a film or a radio or television programme giving facts about something
example: There were some interesting interviews in the documentary.
definition_zh: 一部电影、一部广播或电视节目，提供关于某事的事实
example_zh: 纪录片里有一些有趣的访谈。

definition: to give money, food, clothes, etc. to somebody/something, especially a charity
example: donate something to somebody/something, He donated thousands of pounds to charity.
definition_zh: 把钱、食物、衣服等捐给某人或某物，尤其是慈善机构
example_zh: 捐赠给某人/某物，他捐了数千英镑给慈善机构。

definition: in twos or in two parts
example: I thought I was seeing double (= seeing two of something).
definition_zh: 两份或两份
example_zh: 我以为我看到的是双重（=看到两个什么东西）。

definition: a feeling of being uncertain about something or not believing something
example: a feeling of doubt and uncertainty
definition_zh: 一种对某件事感到不确定或不相信某事的感觉
example_zh: 一种怀疑和不确定的感觉

definition: to feel uncertain about something; to feel that something is not true, will probably not happen, etc.
example: doubt something, There seems no reason to doubt her story.
definition_zh: 对某件事感到不确定;觉得某件事不真实，可能不会发生，等等。
example_zh: 怀疑点什么，似乎没有理由怀疑她的说法。

definition: wearing clothes and not naked or wearing clothes for sleeping
example: Hurry up and get dressed.
definition_zh: 穿着衣服但不裸体，或穿睡衣
example_zh: 快点穿好衣服。

definition: a very small amount of liquid that forms a round shape
example: The first drops of rain fell.
definition_zh: 极少量液体形成圆形
example_zh: 第一滴雨落下。

definition: a musical instrument made of a hollow round frame with plastic or skin stretched tightly across one or both ends. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.
example: to play the drum
definition_zh: 一种由中空圆形框架制成的乐器，一端或两端紧绷塑料或皮革。你用鼓棒或手敲击它来演奏它。
example_zh: 打鼓

definition: having drunk so much alcohol that it is impossible to think or speak clearly
example: They were clearly too drunk to drive.
definition_zh: 喝了太多酒，以至于根本无法清晰思考或说话
example_zh: 他们显然醉得不能开车。

definition: caused by somebody/something; because of somebody/something
example: The team's success was largely due to her efforts.
definition_zh: 由某人/某物引起的;因为某人/某物
example_zh: 球队的成功在很大程度上归功于她的努力。

definition: a fine powder that consists of very small pieces of sand, earth, etc.
example: A cloud of dust rose as the truck drove off.
definition_zh: 一种由非常细小的沙粒、泥土等组成的细粉。
example_zh: 卡车驶离时，扬起一团尘土。

definition: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility
example: duty to do something, It is my duty to report it to the police.
definition_zh: 你觉得自己必须做的事，因为这是你的道德或法律责任
example_zh: 有责任做点什么，我有责任向警察报案。

definition: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface
example: a devastating/massive/powerful earthquake
definition_zh: 地球表面突然剧烈震动
example_zh: 一场毁灭性/巨大/强烈的地震

definition: located in the east or facing east
example: eastern Spain
definition_zh: 位于东方或面向东方
example_zh: 西班牙东部

definition: connected with the trade, industry and development of wealth of a country, an area or a society
example: They discussed social, economic and political issues.
definition_zh: 与一个国家、地区或社会的贸易、工业及财富发展相关
example_zh: 他们讨论了社会、经济和政治问题。

definition: the relationship between production, trade and the supply of money in a particular country or region
example: The economy is in recession.
definition_zh: 特定国家或地区生产、贸易与货币供应之间的关系
example_zh: 经济正处于衰退之中。

definition: the outside limit of an object, a surface or an area; the part furthest from the centre
example: I gripped the edge of my desk to steady myself.
definition_zh: 物体、表面或区域的外界;距离中心最远的部分
example_zh: 我抓住桌沿稳住自己。

definition: a person who is in charge of a newspaper, magazine, etc., or part of one, and who decides what should be included
example: the editor of the Washington Post
definition_zh: 负责报纸、杂志等或其一部分的人，负责决定应包含哪些内容
example_zh: 《华盛顿邮报》主编

definition: to teach somebody over a period of time at a school, university, etc.
example: be educated, She was educated in the US.
definition_zh: 在学校、大学等地，在一段时间内教导某人。
example_zh: 她曾在美国接受教育。

definition: having had the kind of education mentioned; having been to the school, college or university mentioned
example: privately educated children
definition_zh: 接受过上述教育类型;曾就读于上述学校、学院或大学
example_zh: 私立教育的孩子

definition: connected with education
example: children with special educational needs
definition_zh: 与教育相关
example_zh: 有特殊教育需求的儿童

definition: producing the result that is wanted or intended; producing a successful result
example: Aspirin is a simple but highly effective treatment.
definition_zh: 产生期望或预期的结果;产生成功的结果
example_zh: 阿司匹林是一种简单但极为有效的治疗方法。

definition: in a way that produces the intended result or a successful result
example: The company must reduce costs to compete effectively.
definition_zh: 以一种能够产生预期结果或成功结果的方式
example_zh: 公司必须降低成本以有效竞争。

definition: an attempt to do something especially when it is difficult to do
example: The project was a team effort.
definition_zh: 尝试做某件事，尤其是在很难做的时候
example_zh: 这个项目是团队合作的结果。

definition: the process of choosing a person or a group of people for a position, especially a political position, by voting
example: presidential/parliamentary/local elections
definition_zh: 通过投票选择个人或一群人担任某一职位，尤其是政治职位的过程
example_zh: 总统/议会/地方选举

definition: a necessary or typical part of something; one of several parts that something contains
example: There are three important elements to consider.
definition_zh: 某物的必要或典型部分;某物所包含的多个部分之一
example_zh: 有三个重要因素需要考虑。

definition: shy, uncomfortable or ashamed, especially in a social situation
example: I've never felt so embarrassed in my life!
definition_zh: 害羞、不自在或羞耻，尤其是在社交场合
example_zh: 我这辈子从没这么尴尬过！

definition: making you feel shy, uncomfortable or ashamed
example: an embarrassing moment/situation
definition_zh: 让你感到害羞、不自在或羞愧
example_zh: 一个令人尴尬的时刻/情境

definition: a sudden serious and dangerous event or situation that needs immediate action to deal with it
example: This is a medical emergency needing urgent treatment with antibiotics.
definition_zh: 突发严重且危险的事件或情况，需要立即采取行动以应对
example_zh: 这是紧急医疗状况，需要用抗生素紧急治疗。

definition: a strong feeling such as love, fear or anger; the part of a person’s character that consists of feelings
example: to show/express your emotions
definition_zh: 强烈的情感，如爱、恐惧或愤怒;一个人性格中由情感组成的部分
example_zh: 表达/表达你的情感

definition: work, especially when it is done to earn money; the state of being employed
example: full-time/part-time employment
definition_zh: 工作，尤其是为了赚钱而工作;就业状态
example_zh: 全职/兼职就业

definition: to remove everything that is in a container, etc.
example: empty something, She emptied the bins, washed the glasses and went to bed.
definition_zh: 把容器里的所有东西都拿出来等等。
example_zh: 倒空了什么东西，她倒空了垃圾桶，洗了杯子，然后上床睡觉。

definition: to give somebody support, courage or hope
example: encourage somebody, We were greatly encouraged by the positive response of the public.
definition_zh: 给别人支持、勇气或希望
example_zh: 鼓励别人，我们深受公众积极回应的鼓舞。

definition: a person who hates somebody or who acts or speaks against somebody/something
example: She didn't have an enemy in the world.
definition_zh: 一个恨某人，或者对某人/某物采取行动或言论的人
example_zh: 她在这世界上没有敌人。

definition: having agreed to marry somebody
example: When did you get engaged?
definition_zh: 答应嫁给某人
example_zh: 你什么时候订婚的？

definition: the activity of applying scientific knowledge to the design, building and control of machines, roads, bridges, electrical equipment, etc.
example: The bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
definition_zh: 将科学知识应用于机器、道路、桥梁、电气设备等的设计、制造和控制的活动。
example_zh: 这座桥是现代工程的杰作。

definition: to interest somebody or make somebody laugh in order to please them
example: The aim of the series is both to entertain and inform.
definition_zh: 为了吸引某人或逗乐某人，以取悦他们
example_zh: 该系列的目标既是娱乐，也是提供信息。

definition: films, music, etc. used to entertain people; an example of this
example: radio, television and other forms of entertainment
definition_zh: 电影、音乐等，用来娱乐人们;一个例子
example_zh: 广播、电视及其他娱乐形式

definition: a door, gate, passage, etc. used for entering a room, building or place
example: the front/back/side entrance of the house
definition_zh: 用于进入房间、建筑物或场所的门、门、通道等
example_zh: 房屋的正门/后门/侧门

definition: an act of going into or getting into a place
example: She made her entry to the sound of thunderous applause.
definition_zh: 进入或进入某个地方的行为
example_zh: 她在雷鸣般的掌声中登场。

definition: connected with the natural conditions in which people, animals and plants live; connected with the environment
example: the environmental impact of pollution
definition_zh: 与人类、动物和植物所处的自然条件相连;与环境相连
example_zh: 污染对环境的影响

definition: one part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts
example: The next episode has not yet been filmed.
definition_zh: 一个故事的一部分，在电视或广播中分成多个部分播出
example_zh: 下一集尚未拍摄。

definition: the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: There is an equal number of boys and girls in the class.
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、价值等方面都和其他东西一样
example_zh: 班上男女生人数相等。

definition: to be the same in size, quantity, value, etc. as something else
example: 2x plus y equals 7 (= 2x+y=7)
definition_zh: 在大小、数量、价值等方面与其他东西相同
example_zh: 2x加y等于7（= 2x+y=7）

definition: to the same degree; in the same or in a similar way
example: Diet and exercise are equally important.
definition_zh: 以同样的程度;以相同或类似的方式
example_zh: 饮食和锻炼同样重要。

definition: the act or a method of escaping from a place or an unpleasant or dangerous situation
example: I had a narrow escape (= I was lucky to have escaped).
definition_zh: 逃离某处或不愉快或危险情境的行为或方法。
example_zh: 我侥幸逃脱了（=我很幸运逃过一劫）。

definition: to get away from a place where you have been kept as a prisoner or not allowed to leave
example: Two prisoners have escaped.
definition_zh: 逃离一个你被囚禁或不被允许离开的地方
example_zh: 两名囚犯逃脱了。

definition: completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation or for a particular activity
example: an essential part/feature of something
definition_zh: 完全必要;在特定情境或特定活动中极为重要
example_zh: 某物的必不可少部分/特征

definition: at the end of a period of time or a series of events
example: Our flight eventually left five hours late.
definition_zh: 在一段时间或一系列事件结束时
example_zh: 我们的航班最终晚点了五个小时。

definition: to consider or study an idea, a subject, etc. very carefully
example: examine something, This study sets out to examine in detail the possible effects of climate change.
definition_zh: 非常仔细地考虑或研究一个想法、一个主题等等
example_zh: 研究某件事，本研究旨在详细探讨气候变化可能带来的影响。

definition: used before you mention something that makes a statement not completely true
example: I didn't tell him anything except that I needed the money.
definition_zh: 在你提到某些让某个陈述不完全真实的事情之前使用。
example_zh: 我什么都没告诉他，只说我需要这笔钱。

definition: an act of giving something to somebody or doing something for somebody and receiving something in return
example: The exchange of prisoners took place this morning.
definition_zh: 一种给予某人某物或为他人做某事，并得到回报的行为
example_zh: 俘虏交换是在今天上午进行的。

definition: to give something to somebody and at the same time receive the same type of thing from them
example: exchange something, to exchange news/information
definition_zh: 把东西送给别人，同时又从他们那里得到同样的回报
example_zh: 交换一些东西，交换新闻/信息

definition: the state of feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm
example: The news caused great excitement among her friends.
definition_zh: 感受到或表现出快乐和热情的状态
example_zh: 这个消息在她的朋友们中引起了极大的兴奋。

definition: a collection of things, for example works of art, that are shown to the public
example: Have you seen the Picasso exhibition?
definition_zh: 一组向公众展示的物品，例如艺术品
example_zh: 你看过毕加索的展览吗？

definition: to become greater in size, number or importance; to make something greater in size, number or importance
example: Metals expand when they are heated.
definition_zh: 在规模、数量或重要性上变得更大;使某物在规模、数量或重要性上变得更大;
example_zh: 金属在加热时会膨胀。

definition: that you think will happen
example: Double the expected number of people came to the meeting.
definition_zh: 你认为会发生的事
example_zh: 出席会议的人数是预期的两倍。

definition: an organized journey with a particular purpose, especially to find out about a place that is not well known
example: to plan/lead/go on an expedition
definition_zh: 一次有明确目的的有组织旅行，尤其是为了探索鲜为人知的地方
example_zh: 计划/领导/参加探险

definition: to have a particular situation affect you or happen to you
example: Many people have never experienced these difficulties first-hand.
definition_zh: 某个特定情况影响你或发生在你身上
example_zh: 许多人从未亲身经历过这些困难。

definition: having knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity
example: an experienced player/teacher
definition_zh: 在某项特定工作或活动中具备知识或技能
example_zh: 一位经验丰富的演奏者/教师

definition: to do a scientific experiment or experiments
example: After experimenting at Columbia University, he realized that fission was the key to releasing nuclear energy.
definition_zh: 进行科学实验或实验
example_zh: 在哥伦比亚大学进行实验后，他意识到裂变是释放核能的关键。

definition: to burst (= break apart) or make something burst loudly and violently, causing damage
example: A second bomb exploded in a crowded market.
definition_zh: 爆炸（=碎裂）或让某物响亮剧烈爆裂，造成损害
example_zh: 第二枚炸弹在拥挤的市场中爆炸。

definition: to travel to or around an area or a country in order to learn about it
example: As soon as we arrived on the island we were eager to explore.
definition_zh: 前往或绕行一个地区或国家以了解它
example_zh: 一到岛上，我们就迫不及待想去探索。

definition: the sudden violent bursting and loud noise of something such as a bomb exploding; the act of deliberately causing something to explode
example: a bomb/nuclear/gas explosion
definition_zh: 比如炸弹爆炸时突然剧烈爆炸和巨大声响;故意让某物爆炸的行为
example_zh: 炸弹/核/毒气爆炸

definition: the selling and transporting of goods to another country
example: a ban on the export of live cattle
definition_zh: 向他国销售和运输货物
example_zh: 禁止出口活牛

definition: to sell and send goods to another country
example: export (something), The islands export sugar and fruit.
definition_zh: 向其他国家销售和寄送货物
example_zh: 出口（某类），岛屿出口糖和水果。

definition: in addition; more than is usual, expected or exists already
example: to pay/cost extra
definition_zh: 此外;比通常、预期或已经存在的还要多
example_zh: 额外付费/额外费用

definition: a thing that is added to something that is not usual, standard or necessary and that costs more
example: The monthly fee is fixed and there are no hidden extras (= unexpected costs).
definition_zh: 一种附加在不常见、不标准或不必要的事物上的东西，而且成本更高的东西
example_zh: 月费固定，没有隐藏额外费用（= 意外费用）。

definition: to be opposite somebody/something; to have your face or front pointing towards somebody/something or in a particular direction
example: face somebody/something, She turned and faced him.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物相对;让你的脸或正面朝向某个人/某物或某个特定方向
example_zh: 面对某个人/某物，她转身面对他。

definition: to some extent but not very
example: fairly simple/easy/straightforward
definition_zh: 在某种程度上，但不算特别
example_zh: 相当简单/简单/直接

definition: well known to you; often seen or heard and therefore easy to recognize
example: to look/sound/seem familiar
definition_zh: 你非常熟悉;经常被看到或听到，因此很容易被识别
example_zh: 让自己看起来/听起来/看起来熟悉

definition: unusually complicated, often in an unnecessary way; intended to impress other people
example: a kitchen full of fancy gadgets
definition_zh: 异常复杂，往往以不必要的方式;旨在给别人留下深刻印象
example_zh: 厨房里满是各种高级小玩意儿

definition: to want something or want to do something
example: fancy something, Fancy a drink?
definition_zh: 想要某样东西，或者想做某件事
example_zh: 想喝点什么吗，想喝一杯？

definition: at a greater distance away from you
example: I saw her on the far side of the road.
definition_zh: 离你更远
example_zh: 我在马路的另一边看到她。

definition: extremely interesting and attractive
example: a fascinating story
definition_zh: 极其有趣且吸引人
example_zh: 一个引人入胜的故事

definition: following a style that is popular at a particular time
example: fashionable clothes/ideas/styles
definition_zh: 遵循当时流行的风格
example_zh: 时尚服饰/创意/风格

definition: to close or join together the two parts of something; to become closed or joined together
example: fasten something, Fasten your seat belts, please.
definition_zh: 将某物的两部分封闭或连接;将两部分闭合或连接在一起
example_zh: 系好安全带，请系好。

definition: a thing that you do to help somebody
example: Could you do me a favour and pick up Sam from school today?
definition_zh: 你为了帮助别人而做的一件事情
example_zh: 你今天能帮我个忙，去接山姆放学吗？

definition: to be frightened of somebody/something or frightened of doing something
example: fear somebody/something, All his employees fear him.
definition_zh: 害怕某人/某物，或者害怕做某事
example_zh: 害怕某个人/某物，他所有的员工都害怕他。

definition: to include a particular person or thing as a special feature
example: feature somebody/something as somebody/something, The film features Cary Grant as a professor.
definition_zh: 将某个特定人物或事物作为特殊功能包含
example_zh: 以某人/某物为主角，影片中由加里·格兰特饰演一位教授。

definition: a structure made of wood or wire supported with posts that is put between two areas of land as a boundary, or around a garden, field, etc. to keep animals in, or to keep people and animals out
example: The two women chatted over the garden fence.
definition_zh: 一种由木头或铁丝制成、用柱子支撑的结构，放置在两块土地之间作为边界，或者围绕花园、田地等，用来限制动物，或防止人和动物进入
example_zh: 两位女士隔着花园围栏聊天。

definition: the activity of being involved in a battle against an enemy
example: Fighting broke out in three districts of the city last night.
definition_zh: 与敌人作战的活动
example_zh: 昨晚，城市的三个地区爆发了战斗。

definition: a box or folded piece of card for keeping loose papers together and in order
example: a box file
definition_zh: 一个盒子或折叠的卡片，用于将散乱的纸张整理在一起并保持秩序
example_zh: 一个盒子文件

definition: connected with money and finance
example: the world's major financial markets/institutions
definition_zh: 与金钱和金融相关
example_zh: 世界主要金融市场/机构

definition: to shoot bullets, etc. from a gun or other weapon
example: The officer ordered his men to fire.
definition_zh: 用枪或其他武器射击子弹等
example_zh: 军官命令手下开火。

definition: the state of being physically healthy and strong
example: a magazine on health and fitness
definition_zh: 身体健康强壮的状态
example_zh: 一本关于健康与健身的杂志

definition: staying the same; not changing or able to be changed
example: These fixed prices give farmers a degree of financial security.
definition_zh: 保持不变;无法改变或无法改变
example_zh: 这些固定价格为农民提供了一定程度的经济保障。

definition: a piece of cloth with a special coloured design on it that may be the symbol of a particular country or organization, may be used to give a signal or may have a particular meaning. A flag can be attached to a pole (= a long thin straight piece of wood or metal) or held in the hand.
example: the Italian flag
definition_zh: 一块带有特殊颜色图案的布料，可能是某个国家或组织的象征，也可能用于传递信号，或具有特定含义。旗帜可以系在杆子上（=一根细长的直木或金属）或手持。
example_zh: 意大利国旗

definition: a large amount of water covering an area that is usually dry
example: The heavy rain has caused floods in many parts of the country.
definition_zh: 大量水覆盖了通常干燥的区域
example_zh: 暴雨已在全国多个地区引发洪灾。

definition: if a place floods or something floods it, it becomes filled or covered with water
example: The cellar floods whenever it rains heavily.
definition_zh: 如果一个地方被洪水淹没，或者有什么东西淹没了它，它就会被水淹没或淹没
example_zh: 每当大雨时，地窖就会进水。

definition: a fine white or brown powder made from grain, especially wheat, and used in cooking for making bread, cakes, etc.
example: Sift the flour and salt into a bowl.
definition_zh: 一种由谷物，尤其是小麦制成的细白或棕色粉末，用于烹饪，制作面包、蛋糕等。
example_zh: 将面粉和盐筛入碗中。

definition: the steady and continuous movement of something/somebody in one direction
example: the flow of an electric current
definition_zh: 某物或某人在一个方向上持续而稳定地运动
example_zh: 电流的流动

definition: to move steadily and continuously in one direction
example: She lost control and the tears began to flow.
definition_zh: 要在一个方向上稳步且持续地移动
example_zh: 她失去了控制，泪水开始流下。

definition: to bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part lies on top of another part
example: fold something, First, fold the paper in half/in two.
definition_zh: 把某样东西，尤其是纸张或布料弯曲，让一部分叠在另一部分之上
example_zh: 折点东西，先把纸对折或对折。

definition: traditional and typical of the ordinary people of a country or community
example: We visited an exhibition of folk art.
definition_zh: 一个国家或社区普通人的传统与典型
example_zh: 我们参观了一个民间艺术展览。

definition: people in general
example: ordinary working-class folk
definition_zh: 一般来说，人们
example_zh: 普通工人阶级民众

definition: the thing or things that you will mention next; the person or people that you will mention next
example: The following is a summary of events.
definition_zh: 接下来要提到的那件事或事情;接下来你要提到的那个人或几个人
example_zh: 以下是事件的概要。

definition: violent physical action used to obtain or achieve something
example: The release of the hostages could not be achieved without the use of force.
definition_zh: 为获得或实现某物而采取的暴力身体行动
example_zh: 没有武力，释放人质是不可能实现的。

definition: to make somebody do something that they do not want to do
example: be forced into doing something, The President was forced into resigning.
definition_zh: 让某人做他们不想做的事
example_zh: 被迫做某件事，总统被迫辞职。

definition: used to say that a particular situation or state will always exist
example: I'll love you forever!
definition_zh: 用来表示某个特定情境或状态将永远存在
example_zh: 我会永远爱你！

definition: a strong border or structure of wood, metal, etc. that holds a picture, door, piece of glass, etc. in position
example: a picture/photo frame
definition_zh: 一个坚固的边框或由木头、金属等构成的结构，用来固定照片、门、玻璃等
example_zh: 图片/相框

definition: to put or make a frame or border around something
example: be framed, The photograph had been framed.
definition_zh: 在某物周围放置或制作框架或边框
example_zh: 被装框，照片被装框了。

definition: to become hard, and often turn to ice, as a result of extreme cold; to make something do this
example: Water freezes at 0°C.
definition_zh: 在极端寒冷中变得坚硬，常常会变成冰;让某物做出这种反应
example_zh: 水在0°C时结冰。

definition: often
example: Buses run frequently between the city and the airport.
definition_zh: 经常
example_zh: 公交车频繁往返于市区和机场之间。

definition: a relationship between friends
example: They formed a close friendship at college.
definition_zh: 朋友之间的关系
example_zh: 他们在大学期间建立了深厚的友谊。

definition: to make somebody suddenly feel afraid
example: frighten (somebody), Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
definition_zh: 让某人突然感到害怕
example_zh: 吓（某人），抱歉，我不是故意吓你的。

definition: afraid; feeling fear
example: a frightened child
definition_zh: 害怕;感受到恐惧
example_zh: 一个害怕的孩子

definition: making you feel afraid
example: a frightening experience/prospect/thought
definition_zh: 让你感到害怕
example_zh: 一段令人恐惧的经历/前景/想法

definition: kept at a very low temperature in order to preserve it
example: frozen peas/fish/pizza
definition_zh: 保持在极低温度以保存
example_zh: 冷冻豌豆/鱼/披萨

definition: to cook something in hot fat or oil; to be cooked in hot fat or oil
example: fry (something), fried fish
definition_zh: 用热油或油烹煮;用热油或油烹煮
example_zh: 炸鱼（什么的），炸鱼

definition: any material that produces heat or power, usually when it is burnt
example: diesel/jet/rocket fuel
definition_zh: 任何产生热量或能量的材料，通常是在燃烧时产生的
example_zh: 柴油/喷气/火箭燃料

definition: a special activity or purpose of a person or thing
example: The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.
definition_zh: 一个人或某物的特殊活动或目的
example_zh: 俱乐部作为一个聚会场所发挥着实用的作用。

definition: the soft thick mass of hair that grows on the body of some animals
example: The cat carefully licked its fur.
definition_zh: 某些动物身上长出的柔软浓密毛发团
example_zh: 猫小心地舔了舔自己的毛。

definition: at or to a greater distance
example: We had walked a bit further than I had realized.
definition_zh: 在或更远的距离
example_zh: 我们走得比我意识到的还要远。

definition: a building for keeping one or more cars or other vehicles in
example: a double garage (= one for two cars)
definition_zh: 用于存放一辆或多辆汽车或其他车辆的建筑物
example_zh: 双车库（= 两个车厢一个）

definition: to come together, or bring people together, in one place to form a group
example: A crowd soon gathered.
definition_zh: 把大家聚在一起，或者把人们聚集在一起，组成一个团体
example_zh: 很快，一群人聚集了起来。

definition: by or to most people
example: The initiative was generally considered a success.
definition_zh: 由大多数人或对大多数人
example_zh: 这一举措普遍被认为是成功的。

definition: all the people who were born at about the same time
example: the younger/older generation
definition_zh: 所有出生时间差不多同时的人
example_zh: 年轻/年长一代

definition: giving or willing to give freely; given freely
example: The gallery was named after its most generous benefactor.
definition_zh: 慷慨给予或愿意慷慨给予;慷慨给予
example_zh: 画廊以其最慷慨的捐助者的名字命名。

definition: calm and kind; doing things in a quiet and careful way
example: a kind and gentle man
definition_zh: 冷静而善良;做事时总是安静而谨慎
example_zh: 一个善良温和的男人

definition: a man who is polite and well educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well
example: You acted like a true gentleman.
definition_zh: 一个彬彬有礼、受过良好教育、举止极佳、举止得体的男人
example_zh: 你表现得像个真正的绅士。

definition: the spirit of a dead person that a living person believes they can see or hear
example: Do you believe in ghosts (= believe that they exist)?
definition_zh: 死者的灵魂，活人相信自己能看到或听到它
example_zh: 你相信有鬼吗（=相信它们存在）？

definition: very large; much larger or more important than similar things usually are
example: The match was shown on a giant screen outside the town hall.
definition_zh: 非常大;比类似事物通常要大得多或更重要
example_zh: 比赛在市政厅外的巨型屏幕上播出。

definition: (in stories) a very large strong person who is often cruel and stupid
example: tales of giants and ogres
definition_zh: （在故事中）一个非常魁梧强壮、常常残忍又愚蠢的人
example_zh: 巨人与食人魔传说

definition: pleased; happy
example: ‘I passed the test!’ ‘I’m so glad.’
definition_zh: 满意;快乐
example_zh: “我通过了测试！”“我真高兴。”

definition: covering or affecting the whole world
example: This year the global economy will grow by about 4 per cent.
definition_zh: 覆盖或影响整个世界
example_zh: 今年全球经济将增长约4%。

definition: a piece of clothing for the hand, made of wool, leather, etc. with separate parts for each finger and the thumb
example: a pair of gloves
definition_zh: 一件为手部设计的衣服，由羊毛、皮革等材质制成，每根手指和拇指各有独立部件
example_zh: 一双手套

definition: a person’s turn to move or play in a game or an activity
example: Whose go is it?
definition_zh: 一个人在游戏或活动中移动或参与的轮流
example_zh: 这是谁的决定？

definition: things that are produced to be sold
example: to produce/buy/sell goods
definition_zh: 那些为销售而生产的物品
example_zh: 生产/买卖商品

definition: a mark given in an exam or for a piece of school work
example: (British English), She got good grades in her exams.
definition_zh: 考试或作业成绩
example_zh: （英式英语），她考试成绩很好。

definition: a person who has a university degree
example: job prospects for graduates
definition_zh: 拥有大学学位的人
example_zh: 毕业生的就业前景

definition: to get a degree, especially your first degree, from a university or college
example: She taught in France after she graduated.
definition_zh: 获得学位，尤其是你的第一个学位，来自大学或学院
example_zh: 毕业后，她在法国任教。

definition: the small hard seeds of food plants such as wheat, rice, etc.; a single seed of such a plant
example: Russia sold 12 million tons of grain abroad last year.
definition_zh: 食用植物如小麦、水稻等的小硬种子;此类植物的单粒种子
example_zh: 去年俄罗斯在海外销售了1200万吨粮食。

definition: feeling or showing thanks because somebody has done something kind for you or has done as you asked
example: Thank you for doing this. I really am so grateful.
definition_zh: 因为有人为你做了善事或按你所求做了，而感到或表达感谢
example_zh: 谢谢你做这件事。我真的非常感激。

definition: the process in people, animals or plants of growing physically, mentally or emotionally
example: Lack of water will stunt the plant's growth.
definition_zh: 人类、动物或植物在身体、心理或情感上成长的过程
example_zh: 缺水会抑制植物生长。

definition: a person, such as a soldier, a police officer or a prison officer, who protects a place or people, or prevents prisoners from escaping
example: prison/border guards
definition_zh: 指保护某地或人员，或阻止囚犯逃脱的人，如士兵、警察或狱警
example_zh: 监狱/边境警卫

definition: to protect property, places or people from attack or danger
example: Armed officers guarded the entrance.
definition_zh: 保护财产、场所或人员免受攻击或危险
example_zh: 持枪警员守卫入口。

definition: feeling ashamed because you have done something that you know is wrong or have not done something that you should have done
example: Matt and Chrissy both looked equally guilty.
definition_zh: 因为你做了明知错误的事，或者没做本该做的事而感到羞愧
example_zh: 马特和克莉茜看起来同样愧疚。

definition: to pass or give something to somebody
example: hand something to somebody, She handed the letter to me.
definition_zh: 传递或送给别人某样东西
example_zh: 把东西交给别人，她把信递给了我。

definition: to attach something, or to be attached, at the top so that the lower part is free or loose
example: hang something + adv./prep., Hang your coat on the hook.
definition_zh: 用来固定某物，或被固定在顶部，使下半部分自由或松脱
example_zh: 挂点东西 + 副词/介词，把外套挂在挂钩上。

definition: the state of feeling or showing pleasure
example: to find true happiness
definition_zh: 感受或表现出愉悦的状态
example_zh: 去寻找真正的幸福

definition: almost no; almost not; almost none
example: There's hardly any tea left.
definition_zh: 几乎没有;几乎没有;几乎没有
example_zh: 茶几乎没剩了。

definition: a very strong feeling of dislike for somebody
example: She gave him a look of real hate.
definition_zh: 对某人的强烈厌恶
example_zh: 她用一种充满真挚仇恨的眼神看了他一眼。

definition: to move in a particular direction
example: Where are we heading?
definition_zh: 要朝特定方向移动
example_zh: 我们要去哪儿？

definition: the title of a news article printed in large letters, especially at the top of the front page on a newspaper or the home page on a news website
example: a newspaper headline
definition_zh: 新闻文章的标题，以大字印刷，尤其是在报纸头版顶部或新闻网站首页
example_zh: 报纸头条

definition: the process of supplying heat to a room or building; a system used to do this
example: to put/turn the heating on
definition_zh: 为房间或建筑物供热的过程;用于实现此目的的系统
example_zh: 打开/打开加热

definition: to a great degree; in large amounts
example: It was raining heavily.
definition_zh: 在很大程度上;而且数量很大
example_zh: 当时下着大雨。

definition: an aircraft without wings that has large blades (= long flat parts) on top that go round. It can fly straight up from the ground and can also stay in one position in the air.
example: a police/rescue helicopter
definition_zh: 一种没有机翼、顶部有大型叶片（=长而扁平的部分）旋转的飞机。它可以从地面直线向上飞行，也可以在空中保持固定姿势。
example_zh: 一架警察/救援直升机

definition: the best, most interesting or most exciting part of something
example: One of the highlights of the trip was seeing the Taj Mahal.
definition_zh: 一件事情中最精彩、最有趣或最令人兴奋的部分
example_zh: 这次旅行的亮点之一是参观了泰姬陵。

definition: to emphasize something, especially so that people give it more attention
example: The report highlighted the importance of exercise to maintain a healthy body.
definition_zh: 强调某件事，尤其是为了让人们给予更多关注
example_zh: 报告强调了锻炼对保持健康身体的重要性。

definition: very
example: It is highly unlikely that she'll be late.
definition_zh: 非常
example_zh: 她迟到的可能性极低。

definition: to give somebody a job
example: She was hired three years ago.
definition_zh: 给别人一份工作
example_zh: 她三年前被录用的。

definition: important in history; likely to be thought of as important at some time in the future
example: the restoration of historic buildings
definition_zh: 在历史上重要;很可能在未来某个时候被认为很重要
example_zh: 历史建筑的修复

definition: connected with the past
example: You must place these events in their historical context.
definition_zh: 与过去相连
example_zh: 你必须将这些事件置于其历史背景中。

definition: always telling the truth, and never stealing or cheating
example: an honest man/woman
definition_zh: 永远说实话，从不偷窃或作弊
example_zh: 一个诚实的男人/女人

definition: very bad or unpleasant; used to describe something that you do not like
example: What horrible weather!
definition_zh: 非常糟糕或令人不快;用来形容你不喜欢的东西
example_zh: 多糟糕的天气！

definition: a feeling of great shock or fear
example: The thought of being left alone filled her with horror.
definition_zh: 一种极大的震惊或恐惧感
example_zh: 想到被单独留下，她心中充满恐惧。

definition: a person who invites guests to a meal, a party, etc. or who has people staying at their house
example: Ian, our host, introduced us to the other guests.
definition_zh: 比如邀请客人参加聚餐、派对等，或者家里有客人住的人
example_zh: 我们的主人伊恩把我们介绍给了其他客人。

definition: to go after wild animals in order to catch or kill them for food, sport or to make money
example: Lions sometimes hunt alone.
definition_zh: 为了获取食物、进行狩猎运动或赚钱而追捕野生动物
example_zh: 狮子有时独自狩猎。

definition: a violent storm with very strong winds, especially in the western Atlantic Ocean
example: A powerful hurricane hit the Florida coast.
definition_zh: 一场风暴猛烈，风力极强，尤其是在西大西洋地区
example_zh: 一场强烈的飓风袭击了佛罗里达海岸。

definition: the need or wish to get something done quickly
example: Take your time—there's no hurry.
definition_zh: 快速完成某件事的需求或愿望
example_zh: 慢慢来——不用着急。

definition: to move or act quickly because there is not much time
example: You'll have to hurry if you want to catch that train.
definition_zh: 要迅速行动或行动，因为时间不多
example_zh: 如果你想赶上那班火车，就得快点。

definition: who or what somebody/something is
example: The police are trying to discover the identity of the killer.
definition_zh: 某人/某物是谁或是什么
example_zh: 警方正在努力查明凶手的身份。

definition: to pay no attention to something
example: He ignored all the ‘No Smoking’ signs and lit up a cigarette.
definition_zh: 对某件事毫无兴趣
example_zh: 他无视所有“禁止吸烟”的标志，点燃了一支烟。

definition: not allowed by the law
example: illegal drugs/firearms/substances
definition_zh: 法律不允许
example_zh: 非法毒品/枪支/物质

definition: existing only in your mind or imagination
example: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the earth.
definition_zh: 只存在于你的脑海或想象中
example_zh: 赤道是绕着地球中央的一条虚构线。

definition: happening or done without delay
example: an immediate reaction/response
definition_zh: 毫不拖延地发生或完成
example_zh: 即时反应/回应

definition: a person who has come to live permanently in a different country from the one they were born in
example: immigrant from…, immigrants from other European countries
definition_zh: 一个永久居住在与出生国不同的人
example_zh: 来自......的移民，来自其他欧洲国家的移民

definition: the powerful effect that something has on somebody/something
example: a positive/a negative/an adverse impact
definition_zh: 某件事对某人/某物产生的强大影响
example_zh: 正面/负面/负面影响

definition: to have an effect on somebody/something
example: impact on/upon somebody/something, Her father's death impacted greatly on her childhood years.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物产生影响
example_zh: 对某人或某事的影响，她父亲的去世对她的童年岁月产生了巨大影响。

definition: a product or service that is brought into one country from another
example: import from…, food imports from abroad
definition_zh: 从另一个国家运入的产品或服务
example_zh: 从......进口，来自国外的食品进口

definition: to bring a product, a service, an idea, etc. into one country from another
example: import something, The country has to import most of its raw materials.
definition_zh: 将产品、服务、理念等从另一个国家带到另一个国家
example_zh: 进口一些东西，国家必须进口大部分原材料。

definition: the quality of being important
example: She stressed the importance of careful preparation.
definition_zh: 重要的品质
example_zh: 她强调了精心准备的重要性。

definition: an idea, a feeling or an opinion that you get about somebody/something, or that somebody/something gives you
example: My first impression of him was favourable.
definition_zh: 你对某个人/某物产生的想法、一种感觉或看法，或者某个人/某物给你的那种想法
example_zh: 我对他的第一印象是不错的。

definition: making you admire them, because they are very large, good, skilful, etc.
example: an impressive performance
definition_zh: 让你对它们产生敬佩，因为它们体型巨大、优秀、技艺高超等等。
example_zh: 令人印象深刻的表现

definition: the act of making something better; the process of something becoming better
example: The economy has shown significant improvement over the past 9 months.
definition_zh: 让某样东西变得更好的过程;让某样东西变得更好的过程
example_zh: 过去九个月经济已显著改善。

definition: extremely
example: It was all incredibly difficult.
definition_zh: 极其
example_zh: 这一切都非常艰难。

definition: used after very and an adjective or adverb to emphasize a statement, description, etc.
example: Thank you very much indeed!
definition_zh: 在 Very 之后使用，以及一个形容词或副词，用来强调某个陈述、描述等。
example_zh: 非常感谢！

definition: to show that something is true or exists
example: indicate something, Initial tests indicate the presence of oxygen.
definition_zh: 以证明某事是真实的或存在的
example_zh: 指示某些迹象，初步测试显示是否存在氧气。

definition: happening not as the main aim, cause or result of a particular action, but in addition to it
example: the indirect effects of the war
definition_zh: 它并不是某一特定行动的主要目的、原因或结果，而是作为其之外的补充
example_zh: 战争的间接影响

definition: located, done or used inside a building
example: an indoor swimming pool
definition_zh: 位于、实施或在建筑物内部使用
example_zh: 室内游泳池

definition: inside or into a building
example: I prefer to stay indoors in this really hot weather.
definition_zh: 建筑物内部或建筑物内部
example_zh: 我更喜欢在这么热的天气里待在室内。

definition: the effect that somebody/something has on the way a person thinks or behaves or on the way that something works or develops
example: His early work shows the influence of Cézanne and Matisse.
definition_zh: 某人或某物对一个人的思维、行为，或某事物的运作或发展产生的影响
