example_zh: 他的早期作品受到了塞尚和马蒂斯的影响。

definition: to have an effect on the way that somebody behaves or thinks, especially by giving them an example to follow
example: influence somebody/something, His writings have influenced the lives of millions.
definition_zh: 影响某人的行为或思维方式，尤其是通过给他们一个榜样来效仿
example_zh: 影响某人/某事，他的著作已经影响了数百万人的生活。

definition: one of the things from which something is made, especially one of the foods that are used together to make a particular dish
example: Mix all the ingredients in a bowl.
definition_zh: 制作某样东西的材料之一，尤其是用来做成某道菜的食材之一
example_zh: 把所有材料都放进碗里搅拌。

definition: to harm yourself or somebody else physically, especially in an accident
example: He injured his knee playing hockey.
definition_zh: 伤害自己或他人，尤其是在事故中
example_zh: 他在打冰球时膝盖受伤了。

definition: physically hurt; having an injury
example: His injured leg prevented him from walking.
definition_zh: 身体受伤;受伤
example_zh: 他受伤的腿让他无法行走。

definition: not guilty of a crime, etc.; not having done something wrong
example: They have imprisoned an innocent man.
definition_zh: 无犯罪等;未做错事
example_zh: 他们把一个无辜的人关进了监狱。

definition: the ability to learn, understand and think in a logical way about things; the ability to do this well
example: a person of high/average/low intelligence
definition_zh: 学习、理解并以逻辑思考事物的能力;能够很好地完成这些
example_zh: 一个智力高/平均/低智商的人

definition: to have a plan, result or purpose in your mind when you do something
example: We finished later than we had intended.
definition_zh: 在你做某件事时，心中有计划、结果或目标
example_zh: 我们比预期晚结束了。

definition: what you intend or plan to do; your aim
example: intention of doing something, I have no intention of going to the wedding.
definition_zh: 你打算或计划做什么;你的目标
example_zh: 我打算做点什么，我根本没打算去参加婚礼。

definition: to buy property, shares in a company, etc. in the hope of making a profit
example: Now is a good time to invest.
definition_zh: 购买房产、公司股份等，希望能盈利
example_zh: 现在是投资的好时机。

definition: to carefully examine the facts of a situation, an event, a crime, etc. to find out the truth about it or how it happened
example: The FBI has been called in to investigate.
definition_zh: 仔细审查一个情况、一个事件、一个犯罪等的事实，以找出其真相或其发生过程
example_zh: 联邦调查局已被召来调查。

definition: taking part in something; being part of something or connected with something
example: Some people tried to stop the fight but I didn't want to get involved.
definition_zh: 参与某件事;成为某事的一部分或与某物建立联系
example_zh: 有些人试图制止争斗，但我不想卷入其中。

definition: a chemical element. Iron is a hard strong metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.
example: iron gates/bars/railings
definition_zh: 一种化学元素。铁是一种坚硬且坚硬的金属，用于制造钢铁，也存在于血液和食物中少量。
example_zh: 铁门/栏杆/栏杆

definition: to make clothes, etc. smooth by using an iron
example: He was ironing when I arrived.
definition_zh: 用熨斗把衣服等弄得更光滑
example_zh: 我到的时候他正在熨衣服。

definition: an important topic that people are discussing or arguing about
example: a key/major issue
definition_zh: 这是一个人们正在讨论或争论的重要话题
example_zh: 关键/重大问题

definition: the study and use of electronic processes and equipment to store and send information of all kinds, including words, pictures and numbers (the abbreviation for ‘information technology’)
example: the increasing use of IT in all aspects of today's society
definition_zh: 研究和使用电子工艺和设备以存储和发送各种信息，包括文字、图片和数字（“信息技术”的缩写）
example_zh: IT在当今社会各个领域的日益广泛应用

definition: a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or profession
example: a scientific/an academic journal
definition_zh: 一份涉及特定主题或职业的报纸或杂志
example_zh: 一本科学/学术期刊

definition: a person in a court who has the authority to decide how criminals should be punished or to make legal decisions
example: a High Court judge
definition_zh: 在法庭上拥有权力决定如何惩罚罪犯或作出法律决定的人
example_zh: 一位高等法院法官

definition: to form an opinion about somebody/something, based on the information you have
example: As far as I can judge, all of them are to blame.
definition_zh: 基于你掌握的信息，对某人或某物形成看法
example_zh: 据我判断，他们全都有责任。

definition: wanting to do something or wanting something to happen very much
example: keen to do something, John was very keen to help.
definition_zh: 非常想做点什么，或者非常希望某件事发生
example_zh: 约翰非常想做点什么，非常乐于帮忙。

definition: to put information into a computer using a keyboard
example: key something, I was busy keying data.
definition_zh: 使用键盘将信息输入计算机
example_zh: 我当时正忙着输入数据。

definition: the set of keys for operating a computer or typewriter, or the set of letters that you can touch to write on a smartphone or tablet
example: The program locks the keyboard until a password is given.
definition_zh: 操作电脑或打字机的按键集合，或您可以触摸以在智能手机或平板上书写的字母集合
example_zh: 程序会锁定键盘，直到输入密码。

definition: a movement with the foot or the leg, usually to hit something with the foot
example: the first kick of the game
definition_zh: 脚或腿的动作，通常是用脚踩点东西
example_zh: 比赛的第一脚踢球

definition: to hit somebody/something with your foot
example: Stop kicking—it hurts!
definition_zh: 用脚踢人/物
example_zh: 别踢了——太疼了！

definition: an act of killing somebody deliberately
example: Their leader condemned the torture and killing of innocent civilians.
definition_zh: 一种故意杀人的行为
example_zh: 他们的领导人谴责了对无辜平民的酷刑和杀害。

definition: caring about others; gentle, friendly and generous
example: a very kind and helpful person
definition_zh: 关心他人;温柔、友好且慷慨
example_zh: 一个非常善良且乐于助人的人

definition: the act of kissing somebody/something
example: Come here and give me a kiss!
definition_zh: 亲吻某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 过来，给我一个吻！

definition: to touch somebody with your lips as a sign of love or sexual desire or when saying hello or goodbye
example: They stood in a doorway kissing (= kissing each other).
definition_zh: 用嘴唇触碰某人，作为爱的象征、性欲，或者说你好、告别时
example_zh: 他们站在门口亲吻（=彼此亲吻）。

definition: the sound of somebody hitting a door, window, etc. with their hand or with something hard to attract attention
example: knock on/at something, There was a knock at the door.
definition_zh: 有人用手或用什么硬物敲门、窗户等以引起注意的声音
example_zh: 敲门声，门外传来敲门声。

definition: a piece of paper, etc. that is attached to something and that gives information about it
example: Always read the label carefully.
definition_zh: 一张附在某物上的纸张等，提供有关该信息的资料
example_zh: 一定要仔细阅读标签。

definition: to fix a label on something or write information on something
example: label something, Make sure that your luggage is clearly labelled.
definition_zh: 为某物贴标签或在某物上写信息
example_zh: 给东西贴标签，确保你的行李有清晰的标签。

definition: a room or building used for scientific research, experiments, testing, etc.
example: a clinical/research laboratory
definition_zh: 用于科学研究、实验、测试等的房间或建筑。
example_zh: 临床/研究实验室

definition: the state of not having something or not having enough of something
example: lack of something, a lack of understanding/knowledge
definition_zh: 缺乏某样东西或缺乏某样东西的状态
example_zh: 缺乏某些东西，缺乏理解/知识

definition: to have none or not enough of something
example: to lack confidence/experience/resources/power
definition_zh: 要么什么都没有，要么不够
example_zh: 缺乏自信/经验/资源/力量

definition: the most recent or newest
example: the latest craze/fashion/trend
definition_zh: 最近的或最新的
example_zh: 最新的热潮/时尚/潮流

definition: to put somebody/something in a particular position, especially when it is done gently or carefully
example: lay somebody/something + adv./prep., He laid a hand on my arm.
definition_zh: 把某人/某物置于特定位置，尤其是在温柔或小心地进行时
example_zh: “让某人/某物”+“准备/准备”，他把手放在了我的手臂上。

definition: a quantity or sheet of something that lies over a surface or between surfaces
example: layer (of something), A thin layer of dust covered everything.
definition_zh: 一个位于表面上或表面之间的某物的数量或片
example_zh: 一层（某物）——一层薄薄的灰尘覆盖了一切。

definition: the position of being ahead of others in a competition or activity
example: Our team took the lead in the second half.
definition_zh: 在竞赛或活动中领先他人的地位
example_zh: 我们的球队在下半场取得领先。

definition: most important or most successful
example: a leading expert/authority/figure/member
definition_zh: 最重要或最成功的
example_zh: 一位领先的专家/权威/人物/成员

definition: a flat green part of a plant, growing from a stem or branch or from the root
example: lettuce/cabbage/oak leaves
definition_zh: 植物的扁平绿色部分，生长在茎、枝或根部
example_zh: 生菜/卷心菜/橡树叶

definition: material made by removing the hair or fur from animal skins and preserving the skins using special processes
example: a leather jacket
definition_zh: 通过去除动物皮毛或毛皮，并通过特殊工艺保存皮毛制成的材料
example_zh: 一件皮夹克

definition: connected with the law
example: the legal profession/system
definition_zh: 与法律相关
example_zh: 法律职业/体系

definition: time when you are not working or studying; free time
example: These days we have more money and more leisure to enjoy it.
definition_zh: 你不工作或学习时的时间;自由时间
example_zh: 如今我们有更多的钱和更多的闲暇时间来享受它。

definition: the size or measurement of something from one end to the other
example: Measure the length of the line from A to B.
definition_zh: 物体从一端到另一端的大小或尺寸
example_zh: 测量从 A 到 B 的直线长度。

definition: having a flat surface that does not slope
example: Pitch the tent on level ground.
definition_zh: 拥有不倾斜的平坦表面
example_zh: 把帐篷搭在平坦的地方。

definition: a statement made by somebody knowing that it is not true
example: to tell a lie
definition_zh: 一个明知不真实的人说的话
example_zh: 说谎

definition: to say or write something that you know is not true
example: You could see from his face that he was lying.
definition_zh: 说或写一些你明知道不是真的话
example_zh: 从他的脸上你就能看出他在撒谎。

definition: the things that you like
example: We all have different likes and dislikes.
definition_zh: 你喜欢的东西
example_zh: 我们每个人都有不同的喜好和不喜欢的东西。

definition: the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed
example: They imposed a strict spending limit.
definition_zh: 允许的数量或最小量
example_zh: 他们设定了严格的开支上限。

definition: to stop something from increasing beyond a particular amount or level
example: measures to limit carbon dioxide emissions
definition_zh: 阻止某项内容增加到某个特定数量或水平之外
example_zh: 限制二氧化碳排放的措施

definition: either of the two soft edges at the opening to the mouth
example: The assistant pursed her lips.
definition_zh: 嘴口处的两个软边之一
example_zh: 助理抿了抿嘴唇。

definition: in the form of a liquid; not a solid or a gas
example: liquid nitrogen
definition_zh: 以液体的形式存在;而不是固体或气体
example_zh: 液氮

definition: a substance that flows freely and is not a solid or a gas, for example water or oil
example: She poured the dark brown liquid down the sink.
definition_zh: 一种自由流动且非固体或气体的物质，例如水或油
example_zh: 她把深棕色的液体倒进了水槽。

definition: pieces of writing that are valued as works of art, especially novels, plays and poems (in contrast to technical books and newspapers, magazines, etc.)
example: English/American/French literature
definition_zh: 被视为艺术作品的文字作品，尤其是小说、戏剧和诗歌（与专业书籍、报纸、杂志等相对）。
example_zh: 英美法文学

definition: living; not dead
example: live animals
definition_zh: 活着;不是死去
example_zh: 活体动物

definition: broadcast at the time of an actual event; played or recorded at an actual performance
example: The show is going out live.
definition_zh: 在实际活动进行时播出;在实际演出中播放或录制的
example_zh: 节目将直播播出。

definition: alive now
example: all living things
definition_zh: 现在还活着
example_zh: 所有生物

definition: money to buy the things that you need in life
example: She earns her living as a freelance journalist.
definition_zh: 钱用来购买你生活中需要的东西
example_zh: 她以自由记者为生。

definition: a person who lives in a particular place or district
example: The locals are very friendly.
definition_zh: 居住在特定地点或区内的人
example_zh: 当地人非常友好。

definition: to find the exact position of somebody/something
example: The mechanic located the fault immediately.
definition_zh: 以确定某人/某物的确切位置
example_zh: 技师立刻找到了故障所在。

definition: if something is located in a particular place, it exists there or has been put there
example: a small town located 30 miles south of Chicago
definition_zh: 如果某物位于某个特定地点，它就已经在那里存在或被放置在那里
example_zh: 一个位于芝加哥以南30英里的小镇

definition: a place where something happens or exists; the position of something
example: a honeymoon in a secret location
definition_zh: 某事发生或存在的地方;某物的位置
example_zh: 在秘密地点度蜜月

definition: unhappy because you have no friends or people to talk to
example: She lives alone and often feels lonely.
definition_zh: 不开心是因为你没有朋友，也没有可以倾诉的人
example_zh: 她独自生活，经常感到孤独。

definition: the state of no longer having something or as much of something; the process that leads to this
example: I want to report the loss of a package.
definition_zh: 不再拥有某样东西，或者说失去了那么多的状态;导致这一过程的过程
example_zh: 我想报告丢失一个包裹。

definition: expensive and of very high quality
example: a luxury hotel/car/apartment
definition_zh: 价格昂贵且质量极高
example_zh: 豪华酒店/汽车/公寓

definition: the fact of enjoying special and expensive things, particularly food and drink, clothes and places
example: a life of unimaginable luxury
definition_zh: 享受特别且昂贵的事物，尤其是食物和饮料、服装和场所
example_zh: 一种难以想象的奢华生活

definition: very stupid; not at all sensible
example: You must be mad to risk it.
definition_zh: 非常愚蠢;一点也不理智
example_zh: 你一定疯了，才敢冒这个险。

definition: having or using special powers to make impossible things happen or seem to happen
example: a magic spell/charm/potion
definition_zh: 拥有或使用特殊能力，让不可能的事情发生或看起来像是发生
example_zh: 魔法咒语/护身符/药剂

definition: the secret power of appearing to make impossible things happen by saying special words or doing special things
example: Do you believe in magic?
definition_zh: 那种通过说出特殊话语或做特殊事情，似乎能让不可能的事情发生的秘密力量
example_zh: 你相信魔法吗？

definition: more than anything else; also used to talk about the most important reason for something
example: They eat mainly fruit and nuts.
definition_zh: 比起其他任何事;也常常谈论某件事最重要的理由
example_zh: 它们主要以水果和坚果为食。

definition: a large building or covered area that has many shops, restaurants, etc. inside it
example: Let's go to the mall.
definition_zh: 一栋大型建筑或有顶区域，内部有许多商店、餐馆等。
example_zh: 我们去商场吧。

definition: the activity of running and controlling a business or similar organization
example: a career in management
definition_zh: 经营和控制企业或类似组织的活动
example_zh: 管理事业

definition: to advertise a product in a particular way in order to make people want it
example: market something, The company utilizes every media tool available to market its products.
definition_zh: 以特定方式宣传产品，以吸引人们想要它
example_zh: 推广某样东西，公司利用所有可用的媒体工具来推广其产品。

definition: the activity of presenting, advertising and selling a company’s products or services in the best possible way
example: a marketing campaign/strategy
definition_zh: 以最佳方式展示、宣传和销售公司的产品或服务的活动
example_zh: 营销活动/策略

definition: the legal relationship between two people who are married to each other
example: a happy/an unhappy marriage
definition_zh: 两个已婚人士之间的法律关系
example_zh: 一段幸福/不幸福的婚姻

definition: while something else is happening
example: Leave the cake to cool completely. Meanwhile, make the topping.
definition_zh: 而与此同时，还有别的事情正在发生
example_zh: 让蛋糕完全冷却。同时，制作配料。

definition: an official action that is done in order to achieve a particular aim
example: safety/austerity measures
definition_zh: 为实现特定目标而采取的官方行动
example_zh: 安全/紧缩措施

definition: to find the size, quantity, etc. of something in standard units
example: measure something/somebody, a device that measures the level of radiation in the atmosphere
definition_zh: 用标准单位计算某物的大小、数量等
example_zh: 测量某物/某人，一种测量大气中辐射水平的装置

definition: in the middle between a larger and smaller size, amount, length, temperature, etc.
example: There are three sizes—small, medium and large.
definition_zh: 介于大小、数量、长度、温度等之间的中间状态。
example_zh: 有三种尺码——小号、中号和大号。

definition: connected with or happening in the mind; involving the process of thinking
example: the mental process of remembering
definition_zh: 与心灵相连或发生在心中;涉及思考过程
example_zh: 记忆的心理过程

definition: an act of referring to somebody/something in speech or writing
example: He made no mention of her work.
definition_zh: 在言语或书写中提及某人或某物的行为
example_zh: 他没有提及她的工作。

definition: a dirty or untidy state
example: in a mess, The room was in a mess.
definition_zh: 脏乱或杂乱无章的状态
example_zh: 一团糟，整个房间都一团糟。

definition: not severe or strong
example: a mild form of the disease
definition_zh: 不严重也不强烈
example_zh: 一种轻度形式的疾病

definition: a deep hole or holes under the ground where minerals such as coal, gold, etc. are dug
example: a copper/diamond mine
definition_zh: 地下挖出煤、金等矿物的深坑或多个坑
example_zh: 一座铜矿/钻石矿

definition: a combination of different people or things
example: It's a school with a good social and ethnic mix of children.
definition_zh: 不同人或事物的组合
example_zh: 这是一所拥有良好社会和族裔混合的学校。

definition: if two or more substances or things mix or you mix them, they combine, usually in a way that means they cannot easily be separated
example: Oil and water do not mix.
definition_zh: 如果两种或多种物质或物体混合，或者你将它们混合，它们就会结合，通常以一种难以轻易分离的方式
example_zh: 油和水是不能混合的。

definition: a combination of different things
example: She was a curious mixture, part grand lady, part wild child.
definition_zh: 多种因素的组合
example_zh: 她是个奇特的混合体，既有尊贵的女士，也有点野性的孩子。

definition: the way you are feeling at a particular time
example: in a … mood, She's in a good mood today (= happy and friendly).
definition_zh: 你在某个特定时刻的感受
example_zh: 心情......她今天心情很好（=开心又友好）。

definition: a change of place or position
example: Don't make a move!
definition_zh: 地点或位置的变更
example_zh: 别动！

definition: wet earth that is soft and sticky
example: The car wheels got stuck in the mud.
definition_zh: 湿润的泥土，柔软且粘稠
example_zh: 车轮卡进泥里了。

definition: the crime of killing somebody deliberately
example: He was found guilty of murder.
definition_zh: 故意杀人的罪行
example_zh: 他被判谋杀罪名成立。

definition: to kill somebody deliberately and illegally
example: He denies murdering his wife's lover.
definition_zh: 故意且非法地杀人
example_zh: 他否认谋杀了妻子的情人。

definition: a piece of body tissue that you make tight and relax in order to move a particular part of the body; the tissue that forms the muscles of the body
example: a calf/neck/thigh muscle
definition_zh: 一块你用紧致并放松的身体组织，以便运动身体的特定部位;构成身体肌肉的组织
example_zh: 小腿/颈部/大腿肌肉

definition: a play or film in which part or all of the story is told using songs and often dancing
example: a Broadway/Hollywood musical
definition_zh: 一部戏剧或电影，其中部分或全部故事通过歌曲讲述，且常常伴随着舞蹈
example_zh: 百老汇/好莱坞音乐剧

definition: something that is difficult to understand or to explain
example: It is one of the great unsolved mysteries of this century.
definition_zh: 难以理解或解释的事情
example_zh: 这是本世纪最大的未解之谜之一。

definition: the thin hard layer covering the outer tip of the fingers or toes
example: Stop biting your nails!
definition_zh: 覆盖在手指或脚趾外侧的薄而坚硬的一层
example_zh: 别再咬指甲了！

definition: describing events or telling a story
example: narrative fiction
definition_zh: 描述事件或讲述故事
example_zh: 叙事小说

definition: a description of events
example: a gripping narrative of their journey up the Amazon
definition_zh: 事件描述
example_zh: 这是一段扣人心弦的亚马逊之旅叙述

definition: a country considered as a group of people with the same language, culture and history, who live in a particular area under one government
example: European/Arab/Asian nations
definition_zh: 一个国家被视为一个拥有相同语言、文化和历史的群体，他们生活在特定地区，隶属于同一政府
example_zh: 欧洲/阿拉伯/亚洲国家

definition: connected with the place where you were born and lived for the first years of your life
example: your native land/country/city
definition_zh: 与你出生并生活过的最初几年相连
example_zh: 你的祖国/国家/城市

definition: a person who was born in a particular country or area
example: a native of New York
definition_zh: 出生于特定国家或地区的人
example_zh: 纽约本地人

definition: in a way that you would expect
example: Naturally, I get upset when things go wrong.
definition_zh: 以你所期待的方式
example_zh: 自然地，当事情出错时我会感到难过。

definition: used to say that something cannot be avoided
example: The number of places available is necessarily limited.
definition_zh: 以前常说有些事无法避免
example_zh: 可获得的名额数量必然有限。

definition: used to state that something is/was not necessary or that only very little is/was necessary; used to ask if something is/was necessary
example: need (not) do something, You needn't bother asking Rick—I know he's too busy.
definition_zh: 用于说明某件事是/不是必要的，或者只有非常少的事情是/必要的;用于询问某件事是否必要/必要
example_zh: 你不用费心问瑞克——我知道他太忙了。

definition: a small thin piece of steel that you use for sewing, with a point at one end and a hole for the thread at the other
example: a needle and thread
definition_zh: 一小块细钢，用来缝纫，一端尖，另一端有个穿线孔
example_zh: 一根针和一根线

definition: a district or an area of a town; the people who live there
example: We grew up in the same neighbourhood.
definition_zh: 一个城镇的一个区或区域;居住在那里的人
example_zh: 我们在同一个社区长大。

definition: used to show that a negative statement is also true of somebody/something else
example: He didn't remember and neither did I.
definition_zh: 用于表明否定性陈述同样适用于某人/某物
example_zh: 他不记得，我也不记得。

definition: material that is made of string, thread or wire twisted or tied together, with small spaces in between; a piece of this material used for a particular purpose
example: Unfortunately the animals are often caught in fishing nets.
definition_zh: 由绳子、线或铁丝缠绕或系结而成，中间有小空隙的材料;用于特定用途的一块此类材料
example_zh: 不幸的是，这些动物经常被渔网捕获。

definition: a person or thing that is next
example: One moment he wasn't there, the next he was.
definition_zh: 下一个人或事物
example_zh: 一瞬间他还不在，下一刻他就出现了。

definition: and not
example: She seemed neither surprised nor worried.
definition_zh: 又不是
example_zh: 她看起来既不惊讶也不担心。

definition: and not
example: She seemed neither surprised nor worried.
definition_zh: 又不是
example_zh: 她看起来既不惊讶也不担心。

definition: the usual or average state, level or standard
example: above/below normal, The rainfall has been above normal for the time of year.
definition_zh: 通常或平均状态、水平或标准
example_zh: 高于/低于正常水平，该时节的降雨量高于正常水平。

definition: located in the north or facing north; connected with or typical of the north part of the world or a region
example: the northern slopes of the mountains
definition_zh: 位于北方或面向北方;与世界北部或某一地区相连或典型
example_zh: 山脉的北坡

definition: to notice or pay careful attention to something
example: note something, Note the fine early Baroque altar inside the chapel.
definition_zh: 注意或专注关注某件事
example_zh: 注意点什么，注意礼拜堂内精美的早期巴洛克祭坛。

definition: because the thing mentioned is happening or has just happened
example: Now that the kids have left home we've got a lot of extra space.
definition_zh: 因为提到的事情正在发生，或者刚刚发生了
example_zh: 现在孩子们离开家了，我们有了很大的空闲空间。

definition: using, producing or resulting from nuclear energy
example: a nuclear power plant/station
definition_zh: 使用、生产或由核能产生
example_zh: 一座核电站/核电站

definition: easy to see or understand
example: I know you don't like her but try not to make it so obvious.
definition_zh: 易于查看或理解
example_zh: 我知道你不喜欢她，但尽量别太明显。

definition: used when giving information that you expect other people to know already or agree with
example: Obviously, we don't want to spend too much money.
definition_zh: 用于提供你期望其他人已经知道或同意的信息
example_zh: 显然，我们不想花太多钱。

definition: a particular time when something happens
example: on an occasion, on this/that occasion
definition_zh: 某个特定时间，当某件事发生时
example_zh: 在某个场合，在这/那个场合

definition: to happen
example: When exactly did the incident occur?
definition_zh: 发生
example_zh: 这起事件究竟是什么时候发生的？

definition: strange or unusual
example: They're very odd people.
definition_zh: 奇怪或不寻常
example_zh: 他们是非常古怪的人。

definition: agreed to, said, done, etc. by somebody who is in a position of authority
example: an official announcement/decision/statement
definition_zh: 由处于权威位置的人同意、说出、做等
example_zh: 正式公告/决定/声明

definition: not modern; no longer fashionable
example: old-fashioned clothes/styles/methods/equipment
definition_zh: 不再现代;不再流行
example_zh: 老派服装/风格/方法/装备

definition: as soon as; when
example: We didn't know how we would cope once the money had gone.
definition_zh: 一旦;当
example_zh: 我们不知道钱花了之后该如何应对。

definition: the process of cutting open a part of a person’s body in order to remove or repair a damaged part
example: Will I need to have an operation?
definition_zh: 剖开人体某部分以取出或修复受损部位的过程
example_zh: 我需要做手术吗？

definition: involving large numbers of people who work together to do something in a way that has been carefully planned
example: an organized body of workers
definition_zh: 让大量人共同合作，以经过精心规划的方式完成某件事
example_zh: 一个有组织的工人群体

definition: a person who makes the arrangements for something
example: the organizers of the festival
definition_zh: 一个负责安排某事的人
example_zh: 节日的组织者

definition: a document, work of art, etc. produced for the first time, from which copies are later made
example: This painting is a copy; the original is in Madrid.
definition_zh: 一份首次制作的文件、艺术作品等，之后会从中复制
example_zh: 这幅画是复制品;原作收藏于马德里。

definition: used to describe the situation that existed at the beginning of a particular period or activity, especially before something was changed
example: The school was originally very small.
definition_zh: 用于描述某一特定时期或活动开始时所存在的情况，尤其是在某件事发生变化之前
example_zh: 学校最初规模非常小。

definition: used to say what is the right thing to do
example: They ought to apologize.
definition_zh: 过去常说什么才是正确的事
example_zh: 他们应该道歉。

definition: the one or ones that belong to us
example: Their house is very similar to ours, but ours is bigger.
definition_zh: 属于我们的那一个或多家
example_zh: 他们的房子和我们的很像，但我们的更大。

definition: used, happening or located outside rather than in a building
example: outdoor pursuits/recreation/activities
definition_zh: 使用、发生或位于室外而非建筑内
example_zh: 户外活动/休闲/活动

definition: outside, rather than in a building
example: The rain prevented them from eating outdoors.
definition_zh: 在户外，而不是在建筑物内
example_zh: 雨水让他们无法在户外用餐。

definition: a container, usually made of paper, that holds a number of the same thing or an amount of something, ready to be sold
example: pack of something, a pack of cigarettes/gum
definition_zh: 一个容器，通常由纸制成，装有若干相同物品或一定数量的物品，准备出售
example_zh: 一包什么东西，一包香烟/口香糖

definition: something that is wrapped in paper or put into a thick envelope so that it can be sent by mail, carried easily, or given as a present
example: A large package has arrived for you.
definition_zh: 用纸包好或装进厚信封，方便邮寄、携带或作为礼物送出
example_zh: 有个大包裹送来了。

definition: causing you pain
example: Is your back still painful?
definition_zh: 让你痛苦
example_zh: 你的背还疼吗？

definition: having skin that is very light in colour; having skin that has less colour than usual because of illness, a strong emotion, etc.
example: a pale complexion
definition_zh: 皮肤颜色非常浅;因为疾病、情绪强烈等原因导致皮肤颜色比平时偏淡。
example_zh: 苍白的肤色

definition: a metal container used for cooking food in
example: Heat some oil in a pan.
definition_zh: 一种用于烹饪食物的金属容器
example_zh: 在锅里加热一些油。

definition: to take part in or become involved in an activity
example: Anyone who wishes to participate is welcome.
definition_zh: 参与或参与某项活动
example_zh: 欢迎任何愿意参与的人。

definition: especially; more than usual or more than others
example: particularly useful/important/interesting
definition_zh: 尤其是;比平时多，或者比别人多
example_zh: 特别有用/重要/有趣

definition: an official document or ticket that shows that you have the right to enter or leave a place, to travel on a bus or train, etc.
example: a boarding pass (= for a plane)
definition_zh: 一份官方文件或车票，证明你有权进入或离开某地，乘坐公交或火车等。
example_zh: 登机牌（=飞机）

definition: a very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.
example: I admire the passion and commitment shown by the players.
definition_zh: 一种非常强烈的爱、恨、愤怒、热情等情绪。
example_zh: 我钦佩球员们展现出的热情和投入。

definition: a way or track that is built or is made by the action of people walking
example: a dirt/gravel/concrete path
definition_zh: 一种由行人行走行为建造或形成的路径或轨道
example_zh: 一条泥土/碎石/混凝土小径

definition: the act of paying somebody/something or of being paid
example: What method of payment do you prefer?
definition_zh: 支付某人/某物或被支付报酬的行为
example_zh: 你更喜欢哪种付款方式？

definition: not involving a war, violence or argument
example: a peaceful protest/demonstration
definition_zh: 不涉及战争、暴力或争吵
example_zh: 一场和平抗议/示威

definition: the number, amount or rate of something, expressed as if it is part of a total that is 100; a part or share of a whole
example: percentage of something/somebody, What percentage of the population is/are overweight?
definition_zh: 某物的数量、数量或比率，表示为100总数的一部分;整体的一部分或份额
example_zh: 某事/某人的比例，人口中有多少比例超重？

definition: completely
example: It's perfectly normal to feel like this.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 这种感觉完全正常。

definition: the act of performing a play, concert or some other form of entertainment
example: The performance starts at seven.
definition_zh: 表演戏剧、音乐会或其他形式的娱乐行为
example_zh: 演出七点开始。

definition: used to show that you are giving your own opinion about something
example: Personally, I prefer the second option.
definition_zh: 用来表明你在表达自己对某件事的看法
example_zh: 就我个人而言，我更倾向于第二种选择。

definition: to make somebody do something by giving them good reasons for doing it
example: persuade somebody to do something, Try to persuade him to come.
definition_zh: 通过给某人充分理由去做某件事，让他们去做某件事
example_zh: 劝说某人做点什么，试着说服他来。

definition: a person who takes photographs, especially as a job
example: a wedding/wildlife/fashion photographer
definition_zh: 一个拍照的人，尤其是把它当作职业
example_zh: 婚礼/野生动物/时尚摄影师

definition: the art, process or job of taking photographs or filming something
example: Her hobbies include hiking and photography.
definition_zh: 摄影或拍摄某物的艺术、过程或工作
example_zh: 她的爱好包括徒步和摄影。

definition: a short thin piece of stiff wire with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used especially for fastening together pieces of cloth when sewing
example: Use pins to keep the patch in place while you sew it on.
definition_zh: 一根短而细的硬线，一端尖锐，另一端圆头，特别用于缝纫时将布片固定在一起
example_zh: 缝上时用别针固定补丁。

definition: to attach something onto another thing or fasten things together with a pin, etc.
example: She pinned the badge onto her jacket.
definition_zh: 比如把东西固定到另一个东西上，或者用别针把东西固定在一起等等。
example_zh: 她把徽章别在夹克上。

definition: a tube through which liquids and gases can flow
example: Both hot and cold water pipes should be properly insulated.
definition_zh: 一种液体和气体可以流通的管道
example_zh: 热水管和冷水管都应做好良好保温。

definition: to put something in a particular place, especially when you do it carefully or deliberately
example: He placed his hand on her shoulder.
definition_zh: 把东西放在某个特定的位置，尤其是当你小心翼翼或刻意地做的时候
example_zh: 他把手放在她的肩膀上。

definition: the act or process of making plans for something
example: The department is responsible for all financial planning.
definition_zh: 为某事制定计划的行为或过程
example_zh: 该部门负责所有财务规划。

definition: fun, attractive, or giving pleasure
example: a pleasant evening/atmosphere/walk
definition_zh: 有趣、吸引人或带来愉悦
example_zh: 愉快的夜晚/氛围/散步

definition: a state of feeling or being happy or satisfied
example: His eyes lit up with pleasure.
definition_zh: 一种感觉、快乐或满足的状态
example_zh: 他的眼睛因快感而闪烁。

definition: a large amount; as much or as many as you need
example: plenty of eggs/money/time
definition_zh: 数量大;你需要多少或多少
example_zh: 充足的鸡蛋/金钱/时间

definition: the series of events that form the story of a novel, play, film, etc.
example: It's hard to follow the plot of the film.
definition_zh: 构成小说、戏剧、电影等故事的一系列事件。
example_zh: 很难跟上电影的剧情。

definition: used when the two numbers or amounts mentioned are being added together
example: Two plus five is seven.
definition_zh: 当上述两个数字或金额相加时使用。
example_zh: 二加五等于七。

definition: a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their sound and the images they suggest, not just for their obvious meanings. The words are arranged in separate lines, usually with a repeated rhythm, and often the lines rhyme at the end.
example: His collected poems were published after the war.
definition_zh: 一种作品，词语的选择不仅仅因其明显的含义，而是根据发音和所暗示的意象而选择。这些词汇被分成独立行排列，通常有重复的节奏，且常常在句尾押韵。
example_zh: 他的诗集在战后出版。

definition: a person who writes poems
example: an internationally renowned poet
definition_zh: 一个写诗的人
example_zh: 一位享誉国际的诗人

definition: poems in general; poems as a genre of literature
example: lyric/epic poetry
definition_zh: 诗歌总体而言;诗歌作为文学体裁
example_zh: 抒情/史诗诗歌

definition: to stretch out your finger or something held in your hand towards somebody/something in order to show somebody where a person or thing is
example: point at somebody/something, ‘What's your name?’ he asked, pointing at the child with his pen.
definition_zh: 伸出手指或手中拿着的东西，指向某人/某物，以示人某人或某物的位置
example_zh: 指着某个人或某物，“你叫什么名字？”他用笔指着孩子问。

definition: a substance that causes death or harm if it gets into the body
example: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
definition_zh: 一种一旦进入人体就会造成死亡或伤害的物质
example_zh: 有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

definition: to harm or kill a person or an animal by giving them poison
example: poison somebody/yourself, He was believed to poison his enemies.
definition_zh: 通过给人或动物下毒来伤害或杀害他们
example_zh: 毒害某人/自己，人们相信他会毒害他的敌人。

definition: causing death or illness if swallowed or taken into the body
example: poisonous chemicals/fumes/plants
definition_zh: 如果吞下或被摄入体内，会造成死亡或疾病
example_zh: 有毒化学品/烟雾/植物

definition: a plan of action agreed or chosen by a political party, a business, etc.
example: policy on something, the present government’s policy on education
definition_zh: 由政党、企业等同意或选择的行动计划。
example_zh: 关于某项政策，现任政府的教育政策

definition: connected with the state, government or public affairs
example: a monarch without political power
definition_zh: 与国家、政府或公共事务相关的
example_zh: 一位没有政治权力的君主

definition: a person whose job involves politics, especially as an elected member of parliament, etc.
example: democratically elected politicians
definition_zh: 一个工作涉及政治的人，尤其是作为民选议员等。
example_zh: 民主选举产生的政治家

definition: the activities involved in getting and using power in public life, and being able to influence decisions that affect a country or a society
example: world/international politics
definition_zh: 涉及在公共生活中获取和运用权力，以及能够影响国家或社会决策的活动
example_zh: 世界/国际政治

definition: a town or city with a harbour, especially one where ships load and unload goods
example: a container/fishing ports
definition_zh: 一个有港口的小镇或城市，尤其是那种船只装卸货物的地方
example_zh: 集装箱/渔港

definition: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the head and shoulders
example: portrait of somebody, a portrait of his wife
definition_zh: 一幅关于人物的绘画、素描或照片，尤其是头部和肩部
example_zh: 某人的肖像，他妻子的肖像

definition: used to say that something might exist, happen or be true, but you are not certain
example: It was possibly their worst performance ever.
definition_zh: 过去常说某件事可能存在、发生或真实，但你并不确定
example_zh: 这可能是他们有史以来最糟糕的表现。

definition: a deep round container used for cooking things in
example: pots and pans
definition_zh: 一个深而圆的容器，用于烹饪食物
example_zh: 锅碗瓢盆

definition: to make a liquid or other substance flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle
example: pour something + adv./prep., Pour the sauce over the pasta.
definition_zh: 使液体或其他物质从容器中连续流出，尤其是通过将容器倾斜
example_zh: 倒点 + 加料/预料，把酱汁倒在意大利面上。

definition: the state of being poor
example: conditions of extreme/abject poverty
definition_zh: 贫穷状态
example_zh: 极端/极端贫困的条件

definition: a dry mass of very small fine pieces or grains
example: milk/chilli/cocoa powder
definition_zh: 由非常细小的颗粒或颗粒组成的干块
example_zh: 牛奶/辣椒/可可粉

definition: being able to control and influence people and events
example: an incredibly powerful organization
definition_zh: 能够控制和影响人和事件
example_zh: 一个极其强大的组织

definition: connected with real situations rather than with ideas or theories
example: to have gained practical experience of the work
definition_zh: 与真实情境相连，而非与理念或理论相连
example_zh: 获得工作实践经验

definition: to speak to God, especially to give thanks or ask for help
example: They knelt down and prayed.
definition_zh: 与上帝对话，尤其是感谢或寻求帮助
example_zh: 他们跪下祈祷。

definition: words that you say to God giving thanks or asking for help
example: to say your prayers
definition_zh: 你对上帝说的感谢或求助的话语
example_zh: 为你祈祷

definition: a statement that says what you think will happen; the act of making such a statement
example: The results of the experiment confirmed our predictions.
definition_zh: 一种说明你认为会发生什么的陈述;发表这样一句话的行为
example_zh: 实验结果证实了我们的预测。

definition: ready and able to deal with something
example: We'll be better prepared next time.
definition_zh: 准备好并有能力应对某些事情
example_zh: 下次我们会准备得更好。

definition: a meeting at which something, especially a new product or idea, or piece of work, is shown to a group of people
example: presentation on/about somebody/something, The sales manager will give a presentation on the new products.
definition_zh: 一次会议，在会议上，某样东西，尤其是新产品、想法或一件作品，会向一群人展示
example_zh: 关于某人/某事的演示，销售经理将就新产品做一次演示。

definition: newspapers and magazines
example: the local/national/foreign press
definition_zh: 报纸和杂志
example_zh: 本地/全国/外国媒体

definition: to push part of a device, etc. in order to make it work
example: press something, to press a button/key
definition_zh: 推送设备的一部分，等等，以便让它正常工作
example_zh: 按下某项按钮或按键

definition: the act of trying to persuade or to force somebody to do something
example: pressure for something, The pressure for change continued to mount.
definition_zh: 试图说服或强迫某人做某事的行为
example_zh: 对某件事的压力，改变的压力不断增加。

definition: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe something that is not true
example: I'm tired of having to pretend all the time.
definition_zh: 以某种特定方式行事，以让别人相信一些不真实的事情
example_zh: 我厌倦了总是得假装。

definition: happening or existing before the event or object that you are talking about
example: No previous experience is necessary for this job.
definition_zh: 在你所讨论的事件或对象之前发生或存在
example_zh: 这份工作不需要任何相关经验。

definition: at a time before the time that you are talking about
example: The building had previously been used as a hotel.
definition_zh: 在你所说的时间之前
example_zh: 该建筑此前曾被用作酒店。

definition: a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in the Roman Catholic, Anglican and Orthodox Churches
example: a parish priest
definition_zh: 一位有资格在罗马天主教、圣公会和东正教教会中履行宗教职责和仪式的人
example_zh: 一位教区神父

definition: connected with the education of children between the ages of about five and eleven
example: primary teachers
definition_zh: 与大约五至十一岁儿童的教育相关
example_zh: 小学教师

definition: a male member of a royal family who is not king, especially the son or grandson of the king or queen
example: the royal princes
definition_zh: 非国王的王室男性成员，尤其是国王或王后的儿子或孙子
example_zh: 王室王子们

definition: a female member of a royal family who is not a queen, especially the daughter or granddaughter of the king or queen
example: the royal princesses
definition_zh: 王室成员中非王后的女性成员，尤其是国王或王后的女儿或孙女
example_zh: 皇家公主们

definition: the act of producing letters, pictures, patterns, etc. on something by pressing a surface covered with ink (= coloured liquid for printing, drawing, etc.) against it
example: the invention of printing
definition_zh: 通过将涂有墨水（=用于印刷、绘画等的彩色液体）按压在物体上，制作字母、图片、图案等的行为
example_zh: 印刷术的发明

definition: a person who is kept in prison as a punishment, or while they are waiting for trial
example: The number of prisoners serving life sentences has fallen.
definition_zh: 被关押为惩罚或等待审判的人
example_zh: 服无期徒刑的囚犯人数有所下降。

definition: belonging to or for the use of a particular person or group; not for public use
example: The sign said, ‘Private property. Keep out.’
definition_zh: 属于或供特定个人或团体使用;非供公共使用。
example_zh: 牌子上写着：“私人财产。禁止进入。”

definition: a person, a company or a country that grows or makes food, goods or materials
example: French wine producers
definition_zh: 种植或生产食品、商品或材料的个人、公司或国家
example_zh: 法国葡萄酒生产商

definition: the process of growing or making food, goods or materials, especially large quantities
example: food/oil production
definition_zh: 种植或制造食品、商品或材料的过程，尤其是大量生产
example_zh: 食品/石油生产

definition: a type of job that needs special training or skill, especially one that needs a high level of education
example: the medical/legal/teaching profession
definition_zh: 这种工作需要特殊培训或技能，尤其是需要高水平教育的职业
example_zh: 医学/法律/教学职业

definition: the money that you make in business or by selling things, especially after paying the costs involved
example: annual/pre-tax/corporate profits
definition_zh: 你在商业或销售中赚到的钱，尤其是在支付相关成本之后
example_zh: 年度/税前/公司利润

definition: to give a computer, etc. a set of instructions to make it perform a particular task
example: In this class, students will learn how to program.
definition_zh: 给计算机等提供一组指令，使其执行特定任务
example_zh: 在这门课中，学生将学习编程。

definition: to help sell a product, service, etc. or make it more popular by advertising it or offering it at a special price
example: promote something, The band has gone on tour to promote their new album.
definition_zh: 帮助销售产品、服务等，或通过广告或以特别价格促销来提升其受欢迎程度
example_zh: 推广一些东西，乐队已经开始巡演宣传他们的新专辑。

definition: right, appropriate or correct; according to the rules
example: We should have had a proper discussion before voting.
definition_zh: 正确、适当或正确;根据规则
example_zh: 我们本应在投票前进行一次正式讨论。

definition: in a way that is correct and/or appropriate
example: How much money do we need to do the job properly?
definition_zh: 以正确和/或适当的方式
example_zh: 我们需要多少钱才能把工作做好？

definition: a thing or things that are owned by somebody; a possession or possessions
example: personal/stolen property
definition_zh: 某物或物品由某人所有;或多项财产
example_zh: 个人财产/赃物

definition: the expression of strong dislike of or opposition to something; a statement or an action that shows this
example: to hold/organize/join a protest
definition_zh: 对某事表现出强烈的厌恶或反对;表达这一点的陈述或行为
example_zh: 举行/组织/加入抗议活动

definition: to say or do something to show that you disagree with something or think it is bad, especially publicly
example: There's no use protesting, I won't change my mind.
definition_zh: 说或做某件事，表明你不同意某件事或认为它不好，尤其是在公开场合
example_zh: 抗议也没用，我不会改变主意。

definition: feeling pleased and satisfied about something that you own or have done, or are connected with
example: proud parents
definition_zh: 对自己拥有、做过或与某件事有关的事物感到满意和满足
example_zh: 骄傲的父母

definition: to use facts, evidence, etc. to show that something is true
example: prove something, They hope this new evidence will prove her innocence.
definition_zh: 利用事实、证据等来证明某件事是真实的
example_zh: 证明点什么，他们希望这些新证据能证明她的清白。

definition: an act of trying to make something move by taking hold of it and using force to bring it towards you
example: I gave the door a sharp pull and it opened.
definition_zh: 试图通过抓住某样东西并用力将其拉向自己而动起来的行为
example_zh: 我猛地拉门，门就开了。

definition: to make somebody suffer because they have broken the law or done something wrong
example: punish somebody, Those responsible for this crime will be severely punished.
definition_zh: 让某人因为违法或做错事而受苦
example_zh: 惩罚某人，罪行凶手将受到严厉惩罚。

definition: an act or a way of punishing somebody
example: to inflict/impose/mete out punishment
definition_zh: 惩罚某人的行为或方式
example_zh: 施加/施加/施加惩罚

definition: an act of pushing something/somebody
example: She gave him a gentle push.
definition_zh: 一种推某物/某人的行为
example_zh: 她轻轻推了他一把。

definition: an exam that you have passed or a course of study that you have successfully completed
example: academic/educational/professional/vocational qualifications
definition_zh: 您已通过的考试或成功完成的学习课程
example_zh: 学术/教育/专业/职业资格

definition: having passed the exams or completed the training that are necessary in order to do a particular job; having the experience to do a particular job
example: a qualified teacher
definition_zh: 已通过完成为完成特定工作所需的考试或培训;具备完成特定工作所需的经验
example_zh: 合格教师

definition: to reach the standard of ability or knowledge needed to do a particular job, for example by completing a course of study or passing exams
example: How long does it take to qualify?
definition_zh: 达到完成特定工作所需的能力或知识水平，例如完成学习课程或通过考试
example_zh: 资格认证需要多长时间？

definition: a line of people, cars, etc. waiting for something or to do something
example: There were long queues at polling stations.
definition_zh: 一排人、一排车等，在等着什么或者做点什么
example_zh: 投票站前排起了长队。

definition: to wait in a line of people, vehicles, etc. in order to do something, get something or go somewhere
example: queue (up), People queued up outside.
definition_zh: 排队等人、车等，只为做点什么、拿点什么或者去某个地方
example_zh: 排队（向上），人们在外面排队。

definition: to leave your job, school, etc.
example: If I don't get more money I'll quit.
definition_zh: 离开工作、学校等等。
example_zh: 如果拿不到更多钱，我就辞职。

definition: a group of words or a short piece of writing taken from a book, play, speech, etc. and repeated because it is interesting or useful
example: a dictionary of quotations
definition_zh: 一组词汇或一段简短的文字，取自书籍、戏剧、演讲等，并因有趣或有用而重复使用
example_zh: 名言辞典

definition: a group of words or a short piece of writing taken from a book, play, speech, etc. and repeated because it is interesting or useful
example: The essay was full of quotes.
definition_zh: 一组词汇或一段简短的文字，取自书籍、戏剧、演讲等，并因有趣或有用而重复使用
example_zh: 文章里满是引用。

definition: to repeat the exact words that another person has said or written
example: quote something, to quote Shakespeare
definition_zh: 重复另一个人说过或写过的确切话语
example_zh: 引用点什么，引用莎士比亚的话

definition: the sport of racing horses
example: He used to watch the racing on TV in the afternoons.
definition_zh: 赛马运动
example_zh: 他以前下午会在电视上看赛马。

definition: a variety of things of a particular type
example: range of something, The hotel offers a wide range of facilities.
definition_zh: 各种特定类型的事物
example_zh: 酒店提供丰富多样的设施。

definition: not done, seen, happening, etc. very often
example: a rare disease/occurrence/event
definition_zh: 很少见，也不是常见的，等等
example_zh: 罕见疾病/发生/事件

definition: not very often
example: She is rarely seen in public nowadays.
definition_zh: 不常
example_zh: 如今她很少出现在公众场合。

definition: what you do, say or think as a result of something that has happened
example: to provoke/cause/get a reaction
definition_zh: 你因某件事而做什么、说什么、怎么想
example_zh: 挑衅/引发/激发反应

definition: the true situation and the problems that actually exist in life, in contrast to how you would like life to be
example: She refuses to face reality.
definition_zh: 现实情况和生活中真正存在的问题，与你所期望的生活形成鲜明对比
example_zh: 她拒绝面对现实。

definition: a piece of paper or an electronic document that shows that goods or services have been paid for
example: Can I have a receipt, please?
definition_zh: 一张纸质文件或电子文件，显示商品或服务已付款
example_zh: 能给我一张收据吗？

definition: an official suggestion about the best thing to do
example: to accept/reject a recommendation
definition_zh: 关于最佳做法的官方建议
example_zh: 接受/拒绝推荐

definition: a thing you say or write that mentions somebody/something else; the act of mentioning somebody/something
example: reference to somebody/something, She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.
definition_zh: 你说或写的某件事提到了某个人/某件事;提到某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 指的是某个人/某物，她没有提及自己的疾病，只提到了她的未来计划。

definition: to show the image of somebody/something on the surface of something such as a mirror, water or glass
example: be reflected (in something), His face was reflected in the mirror.
definition_zh: 在镜子、水或玻璃等物体表面上展示某人/某物的图像
example_zh: 被倒映在某物中，他的脸映在镜子里。

definition: at regular intervals or times
example: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
definition_zh: 以固定的时间或间隔进行
example_zh: 我们定期会面，讨论项目的进展情况。

definition: to refuse to accept or consider something
example: to reject an argument/a hypothesis/a notion/a plan
definition_zh: 拒绝接受或考虑某件事
example_zh: 拒绝一个论证/假设/一个观念/一个计划

definition: show or make a connection between two or more things
example: relate something, I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.
definition_zh: 展示或建立两个或多个事物之间的联系
example_zh: 说点什么，我发现很难在脑海中把这两个想法联系起来。

definition: connected with something/somebody in some way
example: related to something/somebody, The amount of protein you need is directly related to your lifestyle.
definition_zh: 以某种方式与某事/某人产生联系
example_zh: 与某事或某人有关，你需要多少蛋白质，直接取决于你的生活方式。

definition: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other
example: diplomatic/international/foreign relations
definition_zh: 两个人、两个群体或国家彼此相处的方式或对待彼此的方式
example_zh: 外交/国际/对外关系

definition: considered and judged by being compared with something else
example: You must consider the relative merits of the two plans.
definition_zh: 通过与其他事物比较来考虑和评判
example_zh: 你必须权衡这两种方案的相对优劣。

definition: a person who is in the same family as somebody else
example: a close/distant relative
definition_zh: 一个与他人同属一家的人
example_zh: 近亲/远亲

definition: calm and not anxious or worried
example: He appeared relaxed and confident before the match.
definition_zh: 平静，不焦虑也不担心
example_zh: 赛前他显得轻松自信。

definition: helping you to rest and become less anxious
example: a relaxing evening with friends
definition_zh: 帮助你休息，减轻焦虑
example_zh: 与朋友们度过一个轻松愉快的夜晚

definition: the act of setting a person or an animal free; the state of being set free
example: release of somebody/something, The government has been working to secure the release of the hostages.
definition_zh: 释放一个人或动物的行为;被释放的状态
example_zh: 释放某人/某物，政府一直在努力确保人质的释放。

definition: to let somebody come out of a place where they have been kept or stuck and unable to leave or move
example: release somebody, to release a prisoner
definition_zh: 让某人从被关押或困住、无法离开或移动的地方出来
example_zh: 释放某人，释放囚犯

definition: that can be trusted to do something well; that you can rely on
example: We are looking for someone who is reliable and hard-working.
definition_zh: 可以被信任去做好某件事;你可以信赖的
example_zh: 我们正在寻找一个可靠且勤奋的人。

definition: the belief in the existence of a god or gods, and the activities that are connected with the worship of them, or in the teachings of a spiritual leader
example: Is there always a conflict between science and religion?
definition_zh: 对神的信仰，以及与对神的崇拜相关的活动，或对精神领袖教导的信仰
example_zh: 科学与宗教之间是否总是存在冲突？

definition: connected with religion or with a particular religion
example: religious beliefs/convictions/faith
definition_zh: 与宗教或特定宗教相关的
example_zh: 宗教信仰/信念/信仰

definition: to continue to be something; to be still in the same state or condition
example: remain + adj., to remain silent
definition_zh: 继续存在某种存在;保持在同一状态或状态
example_zh: 保持 + 形容词，保持沉默

definition: to help somebody remember something, especially something important that they must do
example: remind somebody/yourself, I'm sorry, I've forgotten your name. Can you remind me?
definition_zh: 帮助某人记住某些事情，尤其是他们必须做的重要事情
example_zh: 提醒一下某个人/提醒一下你自己，对不起，我忘了你的名字。你能提醒我吗？

definition: far away from places where other people live
example: a remote village/island/location/region
definition_zh: 远离别人居住的地方
example_zh: 一个偏远的村庄/岛屿/地点/地区

definition: an amount of money that you regularly pay so that you can use a house, room, etc.
example: I earn just about enough to pay the rent.
definition_zh: 你经常支付的钱，用来使用房子、房间等。
example_zh: 我挣的钱刚好够付房租。

definition: to regularly pay money to somebody so that you can use something that they own, such as a house, a room, some land, etc.
example: Are you looking to buy or rent?
definition_zh: 定期向某人支付钱财，以便使用他们拥有的东西，比如房子、房间、土地等。
example_zh: 你是想买房还是租房？

definition: an act of repairing something
example: They agreed to pay the costs of any repairs.
definition_zh: 一种修复某物的行为
example_zh: 他们同意承担任何维修费用。

definition: an event that is very similar to something that happened before
example: repeat of something, She didn't want a repeat performance of what had happened the night before.
definition_zh: 一个与之前发生过的事情非常相似的事件
example_zh: 重演某件事，她不想重演昨晚发生的事。

definition: happening, said or done many times
example: repeated absences from work
definition_zh: 发生过、说过或做过很多次
example_zh: 反复缺勤

definition: to be a member of a group of people and act or speak for them at an event, a meeting, etc.
example: The competition attracted over 500 contestants representing eight different countries.
definition_zh: 成为一个群体的一员，并在活动、会议等场合中代表他们行动或发言。
example_zh: 比赛吸引了来自八个不同国家的500多名参赛者参赛。

definition: to ask for something or ask somebody to do something in a polite or formal way
example: request something, She requested permission to film at the White House.
definition_zh: 以礼貌或正式的方式请求某事或请求某人做某事
example_zh: 请求点什么，她请求在白宫拍摄许可。

definition: to need something; to depend on somebody/something
example: require something, These pets require a lot of care and attention.
definition_zh: 需要某样东西;依赖某个人/某物
example_zh: 需要点什么，这些宠物需要大量的照顾和关注。

definition: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you
example: I'll call the restaurant and make a reservation.
definition_zh: 比如为你保留飞机或火车上的座位、酒店房间等安排
example_zh: 我会打电话给餐厅预订。

definition: a supply of something that a country, an organization or a person has and can use, especially to increase their wealth
example: the exploitation of minerals and other natural resources
definition_zh: 一个国家、一个组织或个人拥有并且可以利用的某种物质，特别是用来增加其财富的资源
example_zh: 矿产及其他自然资源的开发

definition: a strong feeling of approval of somebody/something because of their good qualities or achievements
example: I have the utmost respect for her and her work.
definition_zh: 对某人或某事的强烈认可，因为他们的优点或成就
example_zh: 我对她和她的工作怀有最高的敬意。

definition: to have a very good opinion of somebody/something; to admire somebody/something
example: I respect Jack's opinion on most subjects.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物有非常好的看法;欣赏某人/某物
example_zh: 我尊重杰克在大多数话题上的观点。

definition: a duty to deal with or take care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong
example: to be in a position of responsibility
definition_zh: 一种处理或照顾某人或某事的责任，这样一旦出了问题，你就可以被指责
example_zh: 处于责任岗位

definition: having the job or duty of doing something or taking care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong
example: responsible for doing something, Mike is responsible for designing the entire project.
definition_zh: 有工作或义务去做某件事或照顾某人/某物，这样一旦出了问题，你可能会被指责
example_zh: 负责执行某件事，迈克负责设计整个项目。

definition: to make something happen
example: A heavy frost could result in loss of the crop.
definition_zh: 让事情发生
example_zh: 严重霜冻可能导致作物损失。

definition: to leave your job and stop working, especially because you have reached a particular age or because you are ill; to tell somebody they must stop doing their job
example: He is retiring next year after 30 years with the company.
definition_zh: 辞去工作并停止工作，尤其是因为你到了某个年龄或因为生病;告诉某人他们必须停止工作
example_zh: 他在公司工作了30年后将于明年退休。

definition: having retired from work
example: a retired doctor/teacher/officer/general
definition_zh: 已从工作岗位退休
example_zh: 一位退休医生/教师/军官/将军

definition: to change your opinions or plans, for example because of something you have learned
example: I can see I will have to revise my opinions of his abilities now.
definition_zh: 比如因为你学到了什么，就改变你的观点或计划
example_zh: 我看来我现在得重新审视一下对他能力的看法了。

definition: an increase in an amount, a number or a level
example: The industry is feeling the effects of recent price rises.
definition_zh: 金额、数字或水平的增加
example_zh: 行业正感受到近期价格上涨带来的影响。

definition: the possibility of something bad happening at some time in the future; a situation that could be dangerous or have a bad result
example: The health risks are very low.
definition_zh: 未来某个时候可能发生不好的事;可能危险或带来不良后果的情况
example_zh: 健康风险非常低。

definition: to put something valuable or important in a dangerous situation, in which it could be lost or damaged
example: He risked his life to save her.
definition_zh: 将贵重或重要的东西置于危险环境中，可能丢失或损坏
example_zh: 他冒着生命危险救了她。

definition: a machine that can perform a complicated series of tasks by itself
example: These cars are built by robots.
definition_zh: 一台能够独立完成复杂任务的机器
example_zh: 这些车是由机器人制造的。

definition: a small loaf of bread for one person
example: Soup and a roll: £3.50
definition_zh: 一人一份小面包

definition: to turn over and over and move in a particular direction; to make a round object do this
example: + adv./prep., The ball rolled down the hill.
definition_zh: 反复转动并朝特定方向移动;让圆形物体这样做
example_zh: + 进攻/准备，球滚下山坡。

definition: connected with or about love or a sexual relationship
example: a romantic candlelit dinner
definition_zh: 与爱情或性关系相关
example_zh: 一场浪漫的烛光晚餐

definition: very strong thick string made by twisting thinner strings, wires, etc. together
example: The rope broke and she fell 50 metres onto the rocks.
definition_zh: 由细线、线等缠绕在一起制成的非常结实的粗绳
example_zh: 绳索断裂，她从50米高处摔落到岩石上。

definition: having a surface that is not even or regular
example: rough ground
definition_zh: 表面不平整也不规则
example_zh: 崎岖地形

definition: a number of people or things arranged in a straight line
example: We sat in the front row of the theatre.
definition_zh: 若干人或物排成一条直线
example_zh: 我们坐在剧院的前排。

definition: connected with or belonging to the king or queen of a country
example: the royal family
definition_zh: 与某国国王或王后有关联或隶属于该国
example_zh: 王室成员

definition: a game played by two teams of 13 or 15 players, using an oval ball which may be kicked or carried. Teams try to put the ball over the other team’s line.
example: to play a game of rugby
definition_zh: 一种由两队各13人或15人进行的游戏，使用一个椭圆形球，可以踢球或携带。各队尝试将球越过对方的球线。
example_zh: 打一场橄榄球比赛

definition: to control and have authority over a country, a group of people, etc.
example: rule (something), At that time, King John ruled England.
definition_zh: 控制并对一个国家、一个群体拥有权威，等等。
example_zh: 统治（某种东西），那时，约翰王统治着英格兰。

definition: the state of being safe and protected from danger or harm
example: in safety, a place where children can play in safety
definition_zh: 安全且免受危险或伤害的状态
example_zh: 在安全中，一个孩子们可以安全玩耍的地方

definition: a sheet of strong cloth which the wind blows against to make a boat or ship travel through the water
example: As the boat moved down the river the wind began to fill the sails.
definition_zh: 一块结实的布，风吹过它，使船只能在水中前行
example_zh: 随着船顺河而下，风开始吹满帆布。

definition: a person who works on a ship as a member of the crew
example: a crew of two officers and 13 sailors
definition_zh: 指在船上作为船员工作的人员
example_zh: 船员包括两名军官和十三名水手

definition: a number of people or things taken from a larger group and used in tests to provide information about the group
example: The interviews were given to a random sample of students.
definition_zh: 从较大群体中提取若干人或事物，用于测试以提供关于该群体的信息
example_zh: 这些访谈是随机抽样的学生进行的。

definition: a substance that consists of very small fine grains of rock. Sand is found on beaches, in deserts, etc.
example: a grain of sand
definition_zh: 一种由极小细小岩石颗粒组成的物质。沙子存在于海滩、沙漠等地。
example_zh: 一粒沙子

definition: to look quickly but not very carefully at a document, etc.
example: scan something for something, I scanned the list quickly for my name.
definition_zh: 快速但不仔细地查看文档等。
example_zh: 扫描某样东西，我迅速扫了一遍名单上的我的名字。

definition: involving science; connected with science
example: a scientific discovery/theory/fact
definition_zh: 涉及科学;与科学相关的
example_zh: 一项科学发现/理论/事实

definition: a written text of a play, film, broadcast, talk, etc.
example: That line isn't in the original script.
definition_zh: 戏剧、电影、广播、谈话等的书面文本。
example_zh: 这句话不在原剧本里。

definition: a work of art that is a solid figure or object made by carving or shaping wood, stone, clay, metal, etc.
example: a marble sculpture of Venus
definition_zh: 一种艺术作品，是由雕刻或塑造木材、石头、粘土、金属等材料制成的实体形象或物体。
example_zh: 一尊大理石维纳斯雕塑

definition: connected with teaching children of 11–18 years
example: secondary teachers
definition_zh: 与教授11至18岁儿童相关
example_zh: 中学教师

definition: the activities involved in protecting a country, building or person against attack, danger, etc.
example: national/homeland security (= the defence of a country)
definition_zh: 保护一个国家、建筑或个人免受攻击、危险等的活动。
example_zh: 国家/国土安全（=国家防卫）

definition: the small hard part produced by a plant, from which a new plant can grow
example: a packet of wild flower seeds
definition_zh: 植物产生的小而坚硬的部分，从中可以长出新植物
example_zh: 一包野花种子

definition: able to make good judgements based on reason and experience rather than emotion; practical
example: She's a sensible sort of person.
definition_zh: 能够基于理性和经验而非情绪做出良好判断;务实
example_zh: 她是个理智的人。

definition: to divide into different parts or groups; to divide things into different parts or groups
example: Stir the sauce constantly so that it does not separate.
definition_zh: 将事物划分为不同的部分或小组;将事物划分为不同的部分或小组
example_zh: 不停搅拌酱汁，避免分离。

definition: in a serious way
example: to be seriously ill/injured/wounded/hurt
definition_zh: 以一种严肃的方式
example_zh: 严重生病/受伤/受伤/受伤

definition: a person who works in another person’s house, and cooks, cleans, etc. for them
example: a domestic servant
definition_zh: 一个在别人家里工作、为别人做饭、打扫等的人
example_zh: 一名家政仆人

definition: a group of similar things that belong together in some way
example: a set of six chairs
definition_zh: 一群以某种方式相属的相似事物
example_zh: 一套六把椅子

definition: to prepare or arrange something so that it is ready for use or in position
example: set something, Have you set the alarm clock?
definition_zh: 准备或安排某物使其已准备好使用或就位
example_zh: 设置点什么，你设定闹钟了吗？

definition: an environment where something is located; the place at which something happens
example: a rural/an ideal/a beautiful/an idyllic setting
definition_zh: 某物所在的环境;某事发生的地点
example_zh: 乡村/理想/美丽/田园诗般的环境

definition: the state of being male or female
example: How can you tell what sex a fish is?
definition_zh: 男性或女性的状态
example_zh: 你怎么判断一条鱼的性别？

definition: connected with the physical activity of sex
example: sexual behaviour/activity/desire
definition_zh: 与性行为等身体活动相关
example_zh: 性行为/活动/欲望

definition: an act of shaking somebody/something
example: She gave him a shake to wake him.
definition_zh: 摇晃某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 她摇了摇他，想把他叫醒。

definition: one part of something that is divided between two or more people
example: share of something, Next year we hope to have a greater share of the market.
definition_zh: 某一部分被两个或多人分开
example_zh: 某物份额，明年我们希望能在市场中占据更大的份额。

definition: having a fine edge or point, especially of something that can cut or make a hole in something
example: a sharp knife
definition_zh: 拥有细小的刃口或尖头，尤其是那种能在物体上切割或打洞的东西
example_zh: 一把锋利的刀

definition: a flat board, made of wood, metal, glass, etc., fixed to the wall or forming part of a cupboard, bookcase, etc., for things to be placed on
example: I helped him put up some shelves in his bedroom.
definition_zh: 一块由木头、金属、玻璃等制成的平板，固定在墙上或构成橱柜、书柜等的一部分，用于放置物品
example_zh: 我帮他在卧室装了一些架子。

definition: the hard outer part of eggs, nuts, some seeds, and some animals
example: We collected shells on the beach.
definition_zh: 蛋、坚果、一些种子和一些动物的坚硬外壳
example_zh: 我们在海滩上收集贝壳。

definition: a period of time worked by a group of workers who start work as another group finishes
example: to work a shift
definition_zh: 一组工人工作的时间，在另一组工作结束后开始工作
example_zh: 去上班

definition: to produce or reflect light; to be bright
example: The sun shone brightly in a cloudless sky.
definition_zh: 用于产生或反射光线;以明亮
example_zh: 阳光在无云的天空中明亮地照耀着。

definition: smooth and bright; reflecting the light
example: shiny black hair
definition_zh: 光滑明亮;反射光线
example_zh: 闪亮的黑发

definition: to fire a gun or other weapon; to fire something from a weapon
example: Don't shoot—I surrender.
definition_zh: 开枪或其他武器;从武器中发射某物
example_zh: 别开枪——我投降。

definition: nervous or embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people
example: He is not exactly the shy and retiring type.
definition_zh: 紧张或尴尬于见面和与他人交谈
example_zh: 他并不是那种害羞、内向的人。

definition: the ability to see
example: to lose your sight (= to become blind)
definition_zh: 能够看到
example_zh: 失去视力（= 失明）

definition: a movement or sound that you make to give somebody information, instructions, a warning, etc.
example: a danger/warning/distress signal
definition_zh: 你用来给别人提供信息、指示、警告等时做出的动作或声音。
example_zh: 危险/警告/求救信号

definition: to make a movement or sound to give somebody a message, an order, etc.
example: Don't fire until I signal.
definition_zh: 做出动作或声音，传达信息、命令等。
example_zh: 等我发信号别开火。

definition: where there is little or no sound; making little or no sound
example: At last the traffic fell silent.
definition_zh: 几乎没有声音或没有声音;几乎没有声音
example_zh: 终于，车流安静下来。

definition: showing a lack of thought, understanding, or judgement
example: a silly idea/question/name
definition_zh: 缺乏思考、理解或判断力
example_zh: 一个傻乎乎的想法/问题/名字

definition: the state of being similar to somebody/something but not exactly the same
example: similarity between A and B, The report highlights the similarity between the two groups.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物相似但并不完全相同的状态
example_zh: A组和B组之间的相似性，报告强调了两组之间的相似性。

definition: in almost the same way
example: It is a little cheaper than other similarly sized cars.
definition_zh: 几乎以同样的方式
example_zh: 它比其他同尺寸的车稍微便宜一些。

definition: used to emphasize how easy or basic something is
example: To order, simply click here.
definition_zh: 用于强调某件事有多简单或多基础
example_zh: 如需订购，只需点击这里即可。

definition: from a time in the past until a later past time, or until now
example: She went for a run on Monday and has not been seen since.
definition_zh: 从过去的某个时期到更晚的过去，或者直到现在
example_zh: 她周一去跑步了，从那以后就再也没见过她。

definition: to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
example: The ship sank to the bottom of the sea.
definition_zh: 下降到液体或软质物质的表面以下或底部
example_zh: 船沉入海底。

definition: a thin flat piece of bread, meat, cheese, etc. that has been cut off a larger piece; a piece of cake that has been cut from a larger cake
example: Cut the meat into thin slices.
definition_zh: 一小块薄扁的面包、肉、奶酪等，从较大块上切下来;一块从较大蛋糕中切出的蛋糕
example_zh: 将肉切成薄片。

definition: to cut something into slices
example: to slice (up) onions
definition_zh: 把东西切成片
example_zh: 切洋葱（切片）

definition: a little
example: a slightly different version
definition_zh: 一点点
example_zh: 略有不同的版本

definition: to go or to make something/somebody go at a slower speed or be less active
example: Economic growth has slowed a little.
definition_zh: 去做，或者让某物或某人以更慢的速度行驶，或者减少活动
example_zh: 经济增长略有放缓。

definition: looking clean and neat; well dressed in fashionable and/or formal clothes
example: I have to be smart for work.
definition_zh: 看起来干净整洁;穿着时尚和/或正式服装得体
example_zh: 我必须聪明才能工作。

definition: completely flat and even, without any rough areas or holes
example: the smooth surface of the metal
definition_zh: 完全平整均匀，没有粗糙的区域或孔洞
example_zh: 金属的光滑表面

definition: the programs used by a computer for doing particular jobs
example: management/editing software
definition_zh: 计算机用于执行特定任务的程序
example_zh: 管理/编辑软件

definition: the top layer of the earth in which plants, trees, etc. grow
example: instruments for measuring soil moisture
definition_zh: 地球的表层，植物、树木等生长在其中
example_zh: 测量土壤水分的仪器

definition: hard; not in the form of a liquid or gas
example: The planet Jupiter may have no solid surface at all.
definition_zh: 坚硬;不是以液体或气体的形式
example_zh: 木星可能根本没有固体表面。

definition: a substance or an object that is solid, not a liquid or a gas
example: liquids and solids
definition_zh: 一种固体物质或物体，而非液体或气体
example_zh: 液体和固体

definition: to arrange things in groups or in a particular order according to their type, etc.; to separate things of one type from others
example: sort something, I started at the bottom, answering phones and sorting the mail.
definition_zh: 根据事物类型将事物按组或按特定顺序排列，等等;将某一类型的事物与其他类型区分开来
example_zh: 我从最底层开始，接电话、整理邮件。

definition: located in the south or facing south; connected with or typical of the south part of the world or a region
example: the southern slopes of the mountains
definition_zh: 位于南方或面向南方;与世界南部或某一地区相连或典型
example_zh: 山脉的南坡

definition: connected with or intended for one particular thing only
example: liquid vitamins specifically designed for children
definition_zh: 仅与某一特定事物相关或意图
example_zh: 专为儿童设计的液体维生素

definition: the amount of money that is spent by a government, an organization or a person
example: to increase/cut/reduce spending
definition_zh: 政府、组织或个人所花费的资金金额
example_zh: 增加/削减/减少支出

definition: having a strong taste because spices have been added to it
example: I don't like spicy food.
definition_zh: 味道浓烈，因为加入了香料
example_zh: 我不喜欢辣的食物。

definition: the part of a person that includes their mind, feelings and character rather than their body
example: You are underestimating the power of the human spirit to overcome difficulties.
definition_zh: 一个人的部分包括了他们的思想、情感和性格，而非身体
example_zh: 你低估了人类精神克服困难的力量。

definition: involving speaking rather than writing; expressed in speech rather than in writing
example: spoken English
definition_zh: 以口语而非书写方式表达;以口语而非书面形式表达
example_zh: 口语英语

definition: a small round area that has a different colour or feels different from the surface it is on
example: Which has spots, the leopard or the tiger?
definition_zh: 一个小圆块，颜色或触感与表面不同
example_zh: 豹子还是老虎，哪种有斑点？

definition: to affect or make something affect, be known by, or be used by more and more people
example: The news had spread and was causing great excitement.
definition_zh: 以影响或使某物产生影响、被更多人了解或被使用。
example_zh: 消息传开了，引发了极大的轰动。

definition: a large sports ground surrounded by rows of seats and usually other buildings
example: a football/sports stadium
definition_zh: 一个大型运动场，周围是排排座椅，通常还有其他建筑
example_zh: 足球/体育场

definition: all the workers employed in an organization considered as a group
example: medical/nursing/teaching/coaching staff
definition_zh: 将被视为一个群体的组织中所有受雇的工人
example_zh: 医疗/护理/教学/辅导人员

definition: average or normal rather than having special or unusual features
example: the standard rate of tax (= paid by everyone)
definition_zh: 普通或正常，而不是具有特殊或不寻常的特征
example_zh: 标准税率（= 由所有人共同缴纳）

definition: a level of quality, especially one that people think is acceptable
example: There has been a fall in living standards.
definition_zh: 一个质量水平，尤其是人们认为可以接受的水平
example_zh: 生活水平有所下降。

definition: provided or controlled by the government of a country
example: state officials/agencies
definition_zh: 由某国政府提供或控制的
example_zh: 州官员/机构

definition: to formally write or say something, especially in a careful and clear way
example: state something, He has already stated his intention to run for election.
definition_zh: 正式地写或说话，尤其是以谨慎清晰的方式
example_zh: 说点什么吧，他已经表明了参选的意向。

definition: a collection of information shown in numbers
example: Analysis of crime statistics showed high levels of violent crime within the area.
definition_zh: 以数字表示的信息集合
example_zh: 犯罪统计数据分析显示该地区暴力犯罪率很高。

definition: a figure of a person or an animal in stone, metal, etc., usually the same size as in real life or larger
example: a bronze/marble statue
definition_zh: 一个用石头、金属等材质制成的人形或动物形象，通常与现实中大小相同或更大
example_zh: 一尊青铜/大理石雕像

definition: a thin piece of wood that has fallen or been broken from a tree
example: We collected dry sticks to start a fire.
definition_zh: 一小块从树上掉落或折断的木头
example_zh: 我们收集了干柴来生火。

definition: to fix something to something else, usually with a sticky substance; to become fixed to something in this way
example: stick something + adv./prep., He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
definition_zh: 将某物固定于另一物，通常是用黏性物质;以这种方式固定在某物上
example_zh: 贴点东西 + 副词/介词，他在信封上贴了个邮票。

definition: not moving; calm and quiet
example: A fallen tree floated in the still water.
definition_zh: 一动不动;平静而安静
example_zh: 一棵倒下的树漂浮在静止的水面上。

definition: to put something somewhere and keep it there to use later
example: store something, We do not have adequate space to store these documents.
definition_zh: 把东西放到某个地方，然后留在那里以备后用
example_zh: 存放点东西，我们没有足够的空间来存放这些文件。

definition: a person that you do not know
example: There was a complete stranger sitting at my desk.
definition_zh: 一个你不认识的人
example_zh: 我桌前坐着一个完全陌生的人。

definition: the quality of being physically strong
example: He pushed against the rock with all his strength.
definition_zh: 身体强壮的品质
example_zh: 他用尽全力推向岩石。

definition: long, thin material used for tying things together, made of several threads that have been twisted together; a piece of string used to fasten or pull something or keep something in place
example: a piece/length/ball of string
definition_zh: 细长的材料，用来将物品绑在一起，由多根缠绕在一起的线组成;一根用来固定、拉扯或固定物体的绳子;
example_zh: 一小段/一球/一球的绳子

definition: in a way that shows definite and serious opinions or beliefs
example: a strongly worded protest
definition_zh: 以一种明确且严肃的观点或信念的方式
example_zh: 措辞强烈的抗议

definition: a room where radio or television programmes are recorded and broadcast from, or where music is recorded
example: a television/recording studio
definition_zh: 一个用于录制和播出广播或广播电台或音乐的房间
example_zh: 电视/录音棚

definition: used to refer to a substance, material, group of objects, etc. when you do not know the name, when the name is not important or when it is obvious what you are talking about
example: What's all that sticky stuff on the carpet?
definition_zh: 当你不知道某个名称、名称不重要，或者很明显你在说什么时，它用来指某种物质、材料、一组物体等
example_zh: 地毯上那些黏糊糊的东西是怎么回事？

definition: a type of solid, liquid or gas that has particular qualities
example: a sticky substance
definition_zh: 一种具有特定性质的固体、液体或气体类型
example_zh: 一种粘性物质

definition: in a way that achieves your aims or what was intended
example: She had already successfully completed these courses.
definition_zh: 以一种能够实现你目标或预期的方式
example_zh: 她已经成功完成了这些课程。

definition: happening or done quickly and unexpectedly
example: News of his sudden and unexpected death came as a great shock.
definition_zh: 发生或迅速且出乎意料地完成
example_zh: 他突然去世的消息让他震惊不已。

definition: to be badly affected by a disease, pain, sad feelings, a lack of something, etc.
example: I hate to see animals suffering.
definition_zh: 被疾病、疼痛、悲伤情绪、缺乏某些东西等严重影响。
example_zh: 我讨厌看到动物受苦。

definition: to be convenient or useful for somebody
example: suit somebody/something, If we met at two, would that suit you?
definition_zh: 为某人方便或有用
example_zh: 适合某个人/某物，如果我们两点见面，你觉得合适吗？

definition: right or appropriate for a particular purpose or occasion
example: a suitable candidate
definition_zh: 适用于特定目的或场合的权利
example_zh: 合适的候选人

definition: to give a summary of something
example: This essay briefly summarizes some of our approaches.
definition_zh: 给出某件事的总结
example_zh: 本文简要总结了我们的一些方法。

definition: a short statement that gives only the main points of something, not the details
example: a news summary
definition_zh: 一句只讲述要点而不讲细节的简短陈述
example_zh: 新闻摘要

definition: an amount of something that is provided or available to be used
example: Advances in agriculture increased the food supply.
definition_zh: 提供或可用资源的数量
example_zh: 农业进步增加了粮食供应。

definition: to provide somebody/something with something that they need or want, especially in large quantities
example: supply something to somebody/something, The company supplied sports equipment to schools.
definition_zh: 为某人/某物提供他们需要或想要的东西，尤其是大量供应
example_zh: 给某人/某物提供某样东西，这家公司向学校供应体育器材。

definition: a person who supports a political party, an idea, etc.
example: a strong/loyal/staunch/ardent supporter
definition_zh: 一个支持某个政党、一个理念的人等等。
example_zh: 一个坚定/忠诚/坚定/热情的支持者

definition: used to show that you are almost certain of what you are saying and want other people to agree with you
example: Surely we should do something about it?
definition_zh: 用来表明你几乎确定自己说的话，并希望别人同意你的看法
example_zh: 我们难道不应该做点什么吗？

definition: the outside or top layer of something
example: We need a flat, smooth surface to play the game on.
definition_zh: 某物的外层或顶层
example_zh: 我们需要一个平坦、平滑的表面来玩这个游戏。

definition: to continue to live or exist
example: She was the last surviving member of the family.
definition_zh: 继续生活或存在
example_zh: 她是家中最后一位在世的成员。

definition: a period of time during which you swim
example: Let's go for a swim.
definition_zh: 一段你游泳的时间
example_zh: 我们去游泳吧。

definition: to change or make something change from one thing to another
example: switch (over) to something, We're in the process of switching over to a new system of invoicing.
definition_zh: 改变或让某件事从一件事变成另一件事
example_zh: 切换到某样东西，我们正在切换到新的开票系统。

definition: a change in your body or mind that shows that you are not healthy
example: Symptoms include a headache and sore throat.
definition_zh: 你的身体或心智发生的变化，表明你并不健康
example_zh: 症状包括头痛和喉咙痛。

definition: the part that sticks out at the back of the body of a bird, an animal or a fish, which the animal can move from side to side or up and down
example: The dog ran up, wagging its tail.
definition_zh: 指鸟类、动物或鱼体背部突出的部分，动物可以左右移动或上下移动
example_zh: 狗跑了过来，摇着尾巴。

definition: a natural ability to do something well
example: The festival showcases the talent of young musicians.
definition_zh: 一种天生擅长做某事的能力
example_zh: 音乐节展示了年轻音乐家的才华。

definition: having a natural ability to do something well
example: a talented player/musician/artist
definition_zh: 拥有天生擅长做某事的能力
example_zh: 一位才华横溢的演奏者/音乐家/艺术家

definition: a long, narrow piece of material with a sticky substance on one side that is used for sticking things together
example: adhesive/sticky tape
definition_zh: 一块细长的材料，一面带有黏性物质，用于粘合物品
example_zh: 胶带/粘性胶带

definition: money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services. People pay tax according to their income and businesses pay tax according to their profits. Tax is also often paid on goods and services.
example: to pay your taxes
definition_zh: 你必须向政府缴纳的钱，以便政府能够支付公共服务。人们根据收入缴税，企业根据利润缴税。商品和服务也常被缴纳税款。
example_zh: 用来缴纳税款

definition: to put a tax on somebody/something; to make somebody pay tax
example: tax somebody/something, His declared aim was to tax the rich.
definition_zh: 对某人/某物征税;让某人缴税
example_zh: 征税，他宣称的目标是向富人征税。

definition: connected with the practical use of machines, methods, etc. in science and industry
example: We offer free technical support for those buying our software.
definition_zh: 与科学和工业中机器、方法等的实际应用相关
example_zh: 我们为购买我们软件的用户提供免费技术支持。

definition: a particular way of doing something, especially one in which you have to learn special skills
example: management techniques
definition_zh: 一种特定的做事方式，尤其是那种你必须学习特殊技能的做法
example_zh: 管理技术

definition: to be likely to do something or to happen in a particular way because this is what often or usually happens
example: Women tend to live longer than men.
definition_zh: 很可能会以某种方式去做某件事或以某种方式发生，因为这往往或经常会发生
example_zh: 女性通常比男性寿命更长。

definition: a shelter made of a large sheet of canvas, nylon, etc. that is supported by poles and ropes fixed to the ground, and is used especially for camping
example: to put up/take down a tent
definition_zh: 一种由大帆布、尼龙等材料制成的遮蔽棚，由固定在地面的杆子和绳索支撑，特别用于露营
example_zh: 搭帐篷/拆帐篷

definition: to such a degree; so
example: I can't walk that far (= as far as that).
definition_zh: 如此程度;所以
example_zh: 我走不了那么远（=就那么远）。

definition: of or belonging to them
example: Theirs are the children with very fair hair.
definition_zh: 属于或属于他们
example_zh: 他们的孩子是头发非常白皙的孩子。

definition: the subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing or work of art
example: the central/main/key/major theme
definition_zh: 演讲、作品或艺术作品中的主题或主要思想
example_zh: 核心/主旨/关键/主要主题

definition: a formal set of ideas that is intended to explain why something happens or exists
example: theory of something, the theory of evolution/relativity
definition_zh: 一套旨在解释某事为何发生或存在而正式的思想集合
example_zh: 某物理论，进化论/相对论

definition: used to introduce the logical result of something that has just been mentioned
example: He's only 17 and therefore not eligible to vote.
definition_zh: 用于介绍刚刚提到的事物的逻辑结果
example_zh: 他才17岁，因此没有投票资格。

definition: to this degree; so
example: It's about this high (= as high as I am showing you with my hands).
definition_zh: 就此而言;所以
example_zh: 大约这么高（= 我用手展示的高度）。

definition: used especially at the end of a sentence or clause to add a fact or an opinion that makes the previous statement less strong or less important
example: Our team lost. It was a good game though.
definition_zh: 尤其是在句子或子句的结尾时，用来补充一个事实或观点，使前述陈述变得不那么有力或不那么重要
example_zh: 我们队输了。不过那是一场不错的比赛。

definition: despite the fact that
example: Anne was fond of Tim, though he often annoyed her.
definition_zh: 尽管
example_zh: 安妮很喜欢蒂姆，尽管他经常惹她烦。

definition: a passage in the neck through which food and air pass on their way into the body; the front part of the neck
example: a sore throat
definition_zh: 颈部的一条通道，食物和空气通过它进入体内;颈部前部
example_zh: 喉咙痛

definition: in or into every part of something
example: They export their products to markets throughout the world.
definition_zh: 在某物的每一个部分或其中
example_zh: 他们将产品出口到全球各地市场。

definition: in or into every part of something
example: They export their products to markets throughout the world.
definition_zh: 在某物的每一个部分或其中
example_zh: 他们将产品出口到全球各地市场。

definition: held or fixed in position securely; difficult to move, open or separate
example: He kept a tight grip on her arm.
definition_zh: 牢牢固定在应有位置;难以移动、打开或分离
example_zh: 他紧紧抓住她的手臂。

definition: until
example: We're open till 6 o'clock.
definition_zh: 直到
example_zh: 我们营业到六点。

definition: until
example: We're open till 6 o'clock.
definition_zh: 直到
example_zh: 我们营业到六点。

definition: a metal container in which food is sold; the contents of one of these containers
example: Open the tin and drain the tuna.
definition_zh: 用于销售食品的金属容器;其中一个容器内的内容物
example_zh: 打开罐子，把金枪鱼沥干。

definition: very small in size or amount
example: a tiny baby
definition_zh: 体积或数量非常小
example_zh: 一个小宝宝

definition: to give somebody an extra amount of money to thank them for something they have done for you as part of their job
example: Americans were always welcome because they tended to tip heavily.
definition_zh: 给某人额外的钱，以感谢他们作为工作的一部分为你所做的事情
example_zh: 美国人总是受欢迎，因为他们倾向于给小费。

definition: one of the five small parts that stick out from the foot; any similar part on the foot of an animal or bird
example: the big/little toe (= the largest/smallest toe)
definition_zh: 从脚部突出的五个小部分之一;动物或鸟类脚部上的任何类似部位
example_zh: 大脚趾/小脚趾（= 最大/最小脚趾）

definition: the soft part in the mouth that moves around, used for tasting, swallowing, speaking, etc.
example: He clicked his tongue to attract their attention.
definition_zh: 口腔内那个会移动的柔软部分，用于品尝、吞咽、说话等。
example_zh: 他咂了咂舌，想引起他们的注意。
